segments.ne37:68.1: “Mā bhāyi, mahānāma, mā bhāyi, mahānāma, apāpakaṃ te maraṇaṃ bhavissati, apāpikā [apāpikā te (sī.)] kālaṅkiriyā.

segments.ne37:68.5: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikehi.

segments.ne37:75.3: Tena kho pana samayena isidattapurāṇā thapatayo sākete [sādhuke (saṃ. ni.5.1002)] paṭivasanti kenaci deva karaṇīyena.
segments.ne37:75.4: Assosuṃ kho isidattapurāṇā thapatayo “sambahulā kira bhikkhū bhagavato cīvarakammaṃ karonti.
segments.ne37:76.1: Atha kho isidattapurāṇā thapatayo magge purisaṃ ṭhapesuṃ “yadā tvaṃ ambho purisa passeyyāsi bhagavantaṃ āgacchantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ, atha amhākaṃ āroceyyāsī”ti.
segments.ne37:76.2: Dvīhatīhaṃ ṭhito kho so puriso addasa bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ, disvāna yena isidattapurāṇā thapatayo tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā isidattapurāṇe thapatayo etadavoca “ayaṃ so bhante [ayaṃ bhante (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.5.1002] bhagavā āgacchati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, yassadāni kālaṃ maññathā”ti.
segments.ne37:77.1: Atha kho isidattapurāṇā thapatayo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhiṃsu.
segments.ne37:77.2: Atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
segments.ne37:77.3: Isidattapurāṇā thapatayo bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho isidattapurāṇā thapatayo bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.ne37:78.1: “Yadā mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ suṇoma ‘sāvatthiyā kosalesu cārikaṃ pakkamissatī’ti, hoti no tasmiṃ samaye anattamanatā hoti domanassaṃ ‘dūre no bhagavā bhavissatī’ti.
segments.ne37:78.2: Yadā pana mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ suṇoma ‘sāvatthiyā kosalesu cārikaṃ pakkanto’ti, hoti no tasmiṃ samaye anattamanatā hoti domanassaṃ ‘dūre no bhagavā’ti … pe ….
segments.ne37:79.1: “Yadā pana mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ suṇoma ‘kāsīsu magadhesu [kāsīhi māgadhe (saṃ. ni.5.1002)] cārikaṃ pakkamissatī’ti, hoti no tasmiṃ samaye anattamanatā hoti domanassaṃ ‘dūre no bhagavā bhavissatī’ti.
segments.ne37:79.2: Yadā pana mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ suṇoma ‘kāsīsu magadhesu cārikaṃ pakkanto’ti, anappakā no tasmiṃ samaye anattamanatā hoti anappakaṃ domanassaṃ ‘dūre no bhagavā’ti.
segments.ne37:80.1: “Yadā pana mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ suṇoma ‘magadhesu kāsīsu cārikaṃ pakkamissatī’ti, hoti no tasmiṃ samaye attamanatā hoti somanassaṃ ‘āsanne no bhagavā bhavissatī’ti.
segments.ne37:80.2: Yadā pana mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ suṇoma ‘magadhesu kāsīsu cārikaṃ pakkanto’ti, hoti no tasmiṃ samaye attamanatā hoti somanassaṃ ‘āsanne no bhagavā’ti … pe ….
segments.ne37:81.1: “Yadā pana mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ suṇoma ‘kosalesu sāvatthiṃ [sāvatthiyaṃ (sī. ka.)] cārikaṃ pakkamissatī’ti.
segments.ne37:81.2: Hoti no tasmiṃ samaye attamanatā hoti somanassaṃ ‘āsanne no bhagavā bhavissatī’ti.
segments.ne37:82.1: “Yadā pana mayaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ suṇoma ‘sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme’ti hoti anappakā no tasmiṃ samaye attamanatā, hoti anappakaṃ somanassaṃ ‘āsanne no bhagavā’”ti.
segments.ne37:83.1: “Tasmātiha, thapatayo, sambādho gharāvāso rajāpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā, alañca pana vo, thapatayo, appamādāyā”ti.
segments.ne37:83.2: “Atthi kho no, bhante, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā”ti?
segments.ne37:83.3: “Katamo pana vo, thapatayo, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā”ti?
segments.ne37:84.1: “Idha mayaṃ, bhante, yadā rājā pasenadi kosalo uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyātukāmo [gantukāmo (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.5.1002] hoti, ye te rañño pasenadissa kosalassa nāgā opavayhā, te kappetvā yā tā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa pajāpatiyo piyā manāpā, tā [tāsaṃ (sī. ka.)] ekaṃ purato ekaṃ pacchato nisīdāpema, tāsaṃ kho pana, bhante, bhaginīnaṃ evarūpo gandho hoti.
segments.ne37:84.2: Seyyathāpi nāma gandhakaraṇḍakassa tāvadeva vivariyamānassa, yathā taṃ rājakaññānaṃ [rājārahena (sī. ka.)] gandhena vibhūsitānaṃ.
segments.ne37:84.3: Tāsaṃ kho pana, bhante, bhaginīnaṃ evarūpo kāyasamphasso hoti, seyyathāpi nāma tūlapicuno vā kappāhapicuno vā, yathā taṃ rājakaññānaṃ sukhedhitānaṃ.
segments.ne37:84.4: Tasmiṃ kho pana, bhante, samaye nāgopi rakkhitabbo hoti.
segments.ne37:84.7: Na kho pana mayaṃ, bhante, abhijānāma tāsu bhagīnisu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ ñappādentā, ayaṃ kho no, bhante, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅghātataro cāti.
segments.ne37:85.1: “Tasmātiha, thapatayo, sambādho gharāvāso rajāpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā.
segments.ne37:85.3: Catūhi kho thapatayo, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
segments.ne37:86.2: Idha, thapatayo, sutavā ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ … pe … buddho bhagavāti, dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato appaṭivibhattaṃ.
segments.ne37:86.4: Imehi kho, thapatayo, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
segments.ne37:87.1: “Tumhe kho, thapatayo, buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ … pe … buddho bhagavāti, dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … yaṃ kho pana kiñci kule deyyadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ appaṭivibhattaṃ sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi, taṃ kiṃ maññatha, thapatayo, katividhā te kosalesu manussā ye tumhākaṃ samasamā yadidaṃ dānasaṃvibhāgehī”ti?
segments.ne37:87.4: “Lābhā no, bhante, suladdhaṃ no, bhante, yesaṃ no bhagavā evaṃ pajānātī”ti.

segments.ne37:106.3: Tathāgate vā sambuddhe, atha vā tassa sāvake.
segments.ne37:107.1: “‘Evaṃ acintiyā [passa apa. thera 1.1.82] buddhā, buddhadhammā acintiyā;
segments.ne37:109.1: “Idhāhaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ pasannacittaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi “(yathā kho ayaṃ puggalo iriyati, yañca paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno, yañca maggaṃ samārūḷho)[() natthi a. ni.1.43-44; itivu.21].
segments.ne37:109.2: Imamhi cāyaṃ samaye kālaṃ kareyya, yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.ne37:109.4: Cittaṃ hissa, bhikkhave, pasannaṃ, cetopasādahetu [cittappasādahetu (sī. ka.)] kho pana evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī”ti.
segments.ne37:109.5: Etamatthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati –
segments.ne37:110.3: Etamatthañca byākāsi, buddho [satthā (sī. ka.) passa itivu.21] bhikkhūna santike.
segments.ne37:112.5: Kāyassa bhedā sappañño, saggaṃ so upapajjatī”ti.
segments.ne37:113.1: “Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan”ti.
segments.ne37:115.3: Ogāhasi [ogāhase (sī. ka.) passa vi. va.53] pokkharaṇiṃ, padmaṃ chindasi pāṇinā.
segments.ne37:116.1: “Kena te tādiso vaṇṇo, ānubhāvo juti ca te;
segments.ne37:116.3: Uppajjanti ca te bhogā, ye keci manasicchitā.
segments.ne37:118.1: “Pañhaṃ puṭṭhā viyākāsi, sakkassa iti me sutaṃ;
segments.ne37:119.5: Kammassa phalaṃ vipāko, etādisaṃ katapuññā labhantī”ti.
segments.ne37:123.1: “Apicāpi paṃsuthūpesu uddissakatesu dasabaladharānaṃ tatthapi kāraṃ katvā saggesu narā pamodantī”ti.
segments.ne37:125.3: Udakena paṃsuṃ temetvā, thūpaṃ vaḍḍhetha kassapaṃ.
segments.ne37:126.3: Tasmiṃ [yasmiṃ (sī.)] ime devamanujā pasannā, kāraṃ karontā jarāmaraṇā pamuccare”ti.
segments.ne37:128.1: “Uḷāraṃ vata taṃ āsi, yāhaṃ thūpaṃ mahesino;
segments.ne37:129.3: Vinipātaṃ na gacchāmi, thūpaṃ pūjetva [pūjetvā (ka.)] satthuno”ti.
segments.ne37:132.1: “Yaṃ mayā pasutaṃ puññaṃ, tena ca puññena deva sobhaggaṃ;
segments.ne37:133.3: Cittaṃ taṃ me sabbaṃ, laddhaṃ vimuttacittamhi vidhūtalato”ti.
segments.ne37:136.1: “Tasmiñca okappayi dhammamuttamaṃ, tasmiñca dhamme paṇidhesiṃ mānasaṃ;
segments.ne37:136.3: Evaṃ vihārīhi me saṅgamo siyā, bhave kudāsupi ca mā apekkhavā.
segments.ne37:139.1: “Tasseva kammassa vipākato ahaṃ, vimuttacitto akhilo anāsavo;
segments.ne37:139.3: Imehi me antimadehadhāribhi, samāgamo āsihi tāhi tāsihi.
segments.ne37:140.1: “Paccakkhaṃ khvimaṃ avaca tathāgato jino, samijjhate sīlavato yadicchati;
segments.ne37:140.3: Yathā yathā me manasā vicintitaṃ, tathā samiddhaṃ ayamantimo bhavo”ti.
segments.ne37:142.1: “Ekatiṃsamhi kappamhi jino anejo, anantadassī bhagavā sikhīti;
segments.ne37:142.3: Tassāpi rājā bhātā sikhiddhe [sikhaṇḍi (sī.)], buddhe ca dhamme ca abhippasanno.
segments.ne37:144.3: Vātena pupphaṃ patitassa ekaṃ, tāhaṃ gahetvāna tasseva dāsi.
segments.ne37:145.1: “So maṃ avocābhipasannacitto, tuyhameva etaṃ pupphaṃ dadāmi;
segments.ne37:150.3: Ariṭṭhaṃ dhuvabhattena, yaṃ me gehamhi vijjatha.
segments.ne37:151.1: “Tato ca kattiko puṇṇo [kattikā puṇṇā (ka.)], puṇṇamāsī upaṭṭhitā;
segments.ne37:153.3: Deve ceva manusse ca, sandhāvitvā tato cuto.
segments.ne37:154.3: Aḍḍhe kulasmiṃ uppajjiṃ, pāṇehi ca piyataro.
segments.ne37:159.1: “Ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca, ye me vijjiṃsu [vijjhiṃsu (sī.)] āsavā;
segments.ne37:159.3: Sabbe āsuṃ samucchinnā, na ca uppajjare puna.
segments.ne37:163.1: “Uddhaṃ adho sabbadhi vippamutto, ayaṃ ahasmīti [ayamahamasmīti (sī.) passa udā.61] anānupassī;
segments.ne37:163.3: Evaṃ vimutto udatāri oghaṃ, atiṇṇapubbaṃ apunabbhavāyā”ti.
segments.ne37:165.1: “Sīlavato, ānanda, na cetanā [cetanāya (a. ni.11.2)] karaṇīyā ‘kinti me avippaṭisāro jāyeyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.2: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ sīlavato avippaṭisāro jāyeyya.
segments.ne37:165.3: Avippaṭisārinā, ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kinti me pāmojjaṃ jāyeyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.4: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ avippaṭisārino pāmojjaṃ jāyeyya.
segments.ne37:165.5: Pamuditena, ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kinti me pīti jāyeyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.6: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ pamuditassa pīti jāyeyya.
segments.ne37:165.7: Pītimanassa, ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kinti me kāyo passambheyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.8: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ pītimanassa kāyo passambheyya.
segments.ne37:165.9: Passaddhakāyassa ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kintāhaṃ sukhaṃ vediyeyyan’ti.
segments.ne37:165.10: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vediyeyya.
segments.ne37:165.11: Sukhino ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kinti me samādhi jāyeyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.12: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ sukhino samādhi jāyeyya.
segments.ne37:165.13: Samāhitassa ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kintāhaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajāneyyan’ti.
segments.ne37:165.14: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ samāhito yathābhūtaṃ pajāneyya.
segments.ne37:165.15: Yathābhūtaṃ pajānatā, ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kinti me nibbidā jāyeyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.16: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānanto nibbindeyya.
segments.ne37:165.17: Nibbindantena, ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kinti me virāgo jāyeyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.18: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ nibbindanto virajjeyya.
segments.ne37:165.19: Virajjantena ānanda na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kinti me vimutti jāyeyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.20: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ virajjanto vimucceyya.
segments.ne37:165.21: Vimuttena, ānanda, na cetanā karaṇīyā ‘kinti me vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ uppajjeyyā’ti.
segments.ne37:165.22: Dhammatā esā, ānanda, yaṃ vimuttassa vimuttiñāṇadassanaṃ uppajjeyyā”ti.
segments.ne37:167.1: “Yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa;
segments.ne37:167.3: Athassa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā, yato pajānāti sahetudhamman”ti.
segments.ne37:169.1: “Yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa;
segments.ne37:169.3: Athassa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā, yato khayaṃ paccayānaṃ avedī”ti.
segments.ne37:171.1: “Kiṃnu [passa saṃ. ni.2.243] kujjhasi mā kujjhi, akkodho tissa te varaṃ;
segments.ne37:173.1: “Kadāhaṃ nandaṃ passeyyaṃ, āraññaṃ [araññaṃ (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.2.242] paṃsukūlikaṃ;
segments.ne37:175.1: “Kiṃsu chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kiṃsu chetvā na socati;
segments.ne37:175.3: Kissassu [kissassa (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.187] ekadhammassa, vadhaṃ rocesi gotamāti.
segments.ne37:176.1: “Kodhaṃ chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kodhaṃ chetvā na socati;
segments.ne37:176.5: Vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti, taṃ hi chetvā na socatī”ti.
segments.ne37:181.1: “Sattiyā viya omaṭṭho, ḍayhamānova [dayhamāneva (ka.) saṃ. ni.1.21; theragā.39 passitabbaṃ] matthake;
segments.ne37:184.5: Etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe [maraṇaṃ (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.100] pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukhāvahāni.
segments.ne37:185.5: Etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, lokāmisaṃ pajahe santipekkho”ti.
segments.ne37:187.1: “Sukhaṃ sayanti munayo, na te socanti māvidha;
segments.ne37:188.3: Nandibhavaparikkhīṇo [nandīrāgaparikkhīṇo (ka.) saṃ. ni.1.96], so gambhīre na sīdatī”ti.
segments.ne37:191.3: Saccena kittiṃ pappoti, dadaṃ mittāni ganthati;
segments.ne37:191.5: Asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ, evaṃ [save (sī.) passa saṃ. ni.1.246] pecca na socatī”ti.
segments.ne37:194.3: Na taṃ arahati sappañño, manasā anukampituṃ [ananukampitaṃ (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.236].
segments.ne37:195.3: Na tena hoti saṃyutto, yānukampā anuddayā”ti.
segments.ne37:197.1: “Rāgo ca doso ca kutonidānā, aratī ratī [arati rati (ka.) saṃ. ni.1.237; su. ni.273 passitabbaṃ] lomahaṃso kutojā;
segments.ne37:198.1: “Rāgo ca doso ca itonidānā, aratī ratī lomahaṃso itojā;
segments.ne37:199.3: Puthu visattā kāmesu, māluvāva vitatā vane.
segments.ne37:200.1: “Ye naṃ pajānanti yatonidānaṃ, te naṃ vinodenti suṇohi yakkha;
segments.ne37:200.3: Te duttaraṃ oghamimaṃ taranti, atiṇṇapubbaṃ apunabbhavāyā”ti.
segments.ne37:204.1: “Dullabhā [dullabhaṃ (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.87] bhagavā yadidaṃ tuṭṭhī”ti;
segments.ne37:205.4: Yesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, bhāvanāya rato mano”ti.
segments.ne37:207.4: Te chetvā maccuno jālaṃ, ariyā gacchanti kāmadā”ti.
segments.ne37:209.1: “Duggame visame vāpi, ariyā gacchanti kāmada [kāmadā (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.87];
segments.ne37:209.5: Ariyānaṃ samo maggo, ariyā hi visame samā”ti.
segments.ne37:211.1: “Idaṃ hi [passa saṃ. ni.1.101] taṃ jetavanaṃ, isisaṅghanisevitaṃ;
segments.ne37:212.1: “Kammaṃ vijjā ca dhammo ca, sīlaṃ jīvitamuttamaṃ;
segments.ne37:212.3: Etena maccā sujjhanti, na gottena dhanena vā.
segments.ne37:213.3: Yoniso vicine dhammaṃ, evaṃ tattha visujjhati.
segments.ne37:216.3: Yadatītaṃ pahīnaṃ [pahīṇaṃ (sī.) passa ma. ni.3.272] taṃ, appattañca anāgataṃ.
segments.ne37:218.1: “Ajjeva kiccamātappaṃ [kiccaṃ ātappaṃ (sī.)], ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve;
segments.ne37:218.3: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.ne37:221.3: Atthi, bhikkhave, dhammā cakkhunā paññāya ca sacchikātabbā, atthi dhammā satiyā paññāya ca sacchikātabbā, atthi dhammā kāyena paññāya ca sacchikātabbā, atthi dhammā paññāya veditabbā, paññāya ca sacchikātabbā.
segments.ne37:222.1: “Katame ca, bhikkhave, dhammā cakkhunā paññāya ca sacchikātabbā?
segments.ne37:222.2: Dibbacakkhu suvisuddhaṃ atikkantamānusakaṃ cakkhunā paññāya ca sacchikātabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:223.1: “Katame ca, bhikkhave, dhammā satiyā paññāya ca sacchikātabbā?
segments.ne37:224.1: “Katame ca, bhikkhave, dhammā kāyena paññāya ca sacchikātabbā?
segments.ne37:224.2: Iddhividhā nirodhā kāyena paññāya ca sacchikātabbā.
segments.ne37:225.1: “Katame ca, bhikkhave, dhammā paññāya veditabbā, paññāya sacchikātabbā?
segments.ne37:225.2: Āsavānaṃ khaye ñāṇaṃ paññāya veditabbaṃ, paññāya ca sacchikātabban”ti.
segments.ne37:228.5: Yassevaṃ bhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, kuto naṃ [taṃ (udā.34)] dukkhamessatī”ti.
segments.ne37:230.1: Āyasmato ca sāriputtassa cārikādasamaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ kātabbanti.
segments.ne37:232.1: “Yo brāhmaṇo bāhitapāpadhammo, nihuṃhuṅko [nihuhuṅko (sī.) passa udā.4] nikkasāvo yatatto;
segments.ne37:232.3: Vedantagū vūsitabrahmacariyo, dhammena so brahmavādaṃ vadeyya;
segments.ne37:234.1: “Bāhitvā pāpake dhamme, ye caranti sadā satā;
segments.ne37:234.3: Khīṇasaṃyojanā buddhā, te ve lokasmi [lokasmiṃ (sī. ka.) passa udā.5] brāhmaṇā”ti.
segments.ne37:236.1: “Yattha āpo ca pathavī, tejo vāyo na gādhati;
segments.ne37:236.3: Na tattha sukkā jotanti, ādicco nappakāsati;
segments.ne37:236.5: Na tattha candimā bhāti, tamo tattha na vijjati.
segments.ne37:237.1: “Yadā ca attanāvedi [vedī (sī.) passa udā.10], muni monena brāhmaṇo;
segments.ne37:237.3: Atha rūpā arūpā ca, sukhadukkhā pamuccatī”ti.
segments.ne37:239.1: “Yadā sakesu [passa udā.7] dhammesu, pāragū hoti brāhmaṇo;
segments.ne37:241.3: Saṅgā saṅgāmajiṃ muttaṃ, tamahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇan”ti.
segments.ne37:243.1: “Na udakena sucī [suci (sī. ka.) passa udā.9] hoti, bahvettha nhāyatī [nahāyati (sī.)] jano;
segments.ne37:243.3: Yamhi saccañca dhammo ca, so sucī so ca brāhmaṇo”ti.
segments.ne37:245.1: “Yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa;
segments.ne37:247.3: Sabbāni yogāni upātivatto, akiñcano iriyati paṃsukūliko.
segments.ne37:248.3: Ājāniyaṃ jātibalaṃ nisedhaṃ, nidha namassanti pasannacittā.
segments.ne37:249.3: Yassa te nābhijānāma, kiṃ tvaṃ nissāya jhāyasī”ti.
segments.ne37:252.3: Dhārenti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin”ti [savāhanan”ti (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.2.246].
segments.ne37:254.3: Nibbānaṃ adhigantabbaṃ, sabbadukkhappamocanaṃ [sabbagantapamocanaṃ (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.2.238].
segments.ne37:255.3: Dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin”ti.
segments.ne37:258.3: Dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin”ti.
segments.ne37:260.1: “Tathāgato, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto sammāsambuddhoti vuccati.
segments.ne37:260.2: Bhikkhupi, bhikkhave, paññāvimutto rūpassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto paññāvimuttoti vuccati.
segments.ne37:261.1: “Tathāgato, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vedanāya … pe … saññāya … pe … saṅkhārānaṃ … pe … viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto sammāsambuddhoti vuccati.
segments.ne37:261.5: Bhikkhupi, bhikkhave, paññāvimutto viññāṇassa nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto paññāvimuttoti vuccati.
segments.ne37:262.1: “Tatra kho, bhikkhave, ko viseso ko adhippayāso [adhippāyo (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.3.58] kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa paññāvimuttena bhikkhunāti?
segments.ne37:263.1: “Tathāgato, bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido, maggānugā ca, bhikkhave, etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchāsamannāgatā.
segments.ne37:263.2: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhave, viseso, ayaṃ adhippayāso, idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ tathāgatassa arahato sammāsambuddhassa paññāvimuttena bhikkhunā”ti.
segments.ne37:266.3: Tasmā channaṃ vivaretha, evaṃ taṃ nātivassatī”ti.
segments.ne37:267.1: “Channamativassatī”ti saṃkileso,“vivaṭaṃ nātivassatī”ti vāsanā,“tasmā channaṃ vivaretha, evaṃ taṃ nātivassatī”ti ayaṃ saṃkileso ca vāsanā ca.
segments.ne37:268.1: “Cattārome, mahārāja [bhikkhave (a. ni.4.85)], puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
segments.ne37:268.3: Tamo tamaparāyaṇo tamo jotiparāyaṇo joti tamaparāyaṇo joti jotiparāyaṇo”ti.
segments.ne37:268.4: Tattha yo ca puggalo joti tamaparāyaṇo yo ca puggalo tamo tamaparāyaṇo, ime dve puggalā saṃkilesabhāgiyā, yo ca puggalo tamo jotiparāyaṇo yo ca puggalo joti jotiparāyaṇo, ime dve puggalā vāsanābhāgiyā.
segments.ne37:270.1: “Na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanamāhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujapabbajañca [dārujaṃ pabbajañca (saṃ. ni.1.121)];
segments.ne37:270.3: Sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā”ti;
segments.ne37:272.1: “Etaṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanamāhu dhīrā, ohārinaṃ sithilaṃ duppamuñcaṃ;
segments.ne37:272.3: Etampi chetvāna paribbajanti, anapekkhino kāmasukhaṃ pahāyā”ti.
segments.ne37:274.1: “Yañca, bhikkhave, ceteti, yañca pakappeti, yañca anuseti.
segments.ne37:274.2: Ārammaṇametaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā, ārammaṇe sati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa hoti, tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe āyatiṃ [āyati (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.2.38] punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti, āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā sati āyatiṃ [āyati (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.2.38] jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti, evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
segments.ne37:275.1: “No ce, bhikkhave, ceteti, no ce pakappeti, atha ce anuseti.
segments.ne37:275.2: Ārammaṇametaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā, ārammaṇe sati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa [tassa viññāṇassa (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.2.38] hoti, tasmiṃ patiṭṭhite viññāṇe virūḷhe āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti, āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā sati āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti, evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.
segments.ne37:276.1: “Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, no ceva [ca (sī. ka.)] ceteti, no ca pakappeti, no ca anuseti.
segments.ne37:276.2: Ārammaṇametaṃ na hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā, ārammaṇe asati patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti, tasmiṃ appatiṭṭhite viññāṇe avirūḷhe āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti na hoti, āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbattiyā asati āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
segments.ne37:276.3: Evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotī”ti, ayaṃ nibbedho.
segments.ne37:278.1: “‘Samuddo samuddo’ti kho, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano bhāsati, neso, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye samuddo, mahā eso bhikkhave, udakarāsi mahāudakaṇṇavo.
segments.ne37:278.4: Cakkhu, bhikkhave, purisassa samuddo, tassa rūpamayo vego.
segments.ne37:279.1: “Yo taṃ rūpamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari [atāri (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.4.228] cakkhusamuddaṃ saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagahaṃ [sagāhaṃ (saṃ. ni.4.228)] sarakkhasaṃ tiṇṇo pāraṅgato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo”ti.
segments.ne37:280.1: “‘Sotaṃ, bhikkhave … pe … ghānaṃ … pe … jivhā … pe … kāyo … pe … mano, bhikkhave, purisassa samuddo tassa dhammamayo vegoti.
segments.ne37:281.1: “Yo taṃ dhammamayaṃ vegaṃ sahati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atari manosamuddaṃ saūmiṃ sāvaṭṭaṃ sagahaṃ sarakkhasaṃ tiṇṇo pāraṅgato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo”ti.
segments.ne37:281.3: Idamavoca bhagavā, idaṃ vatvāna sugato, athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.ne37:282.3: Sa vedantagū vusitabrahmacariyo, lokantagū pāragatoti vuccatī”ti.
segments.ne37:284.1: “Chayime, bhikkhave, baḷisā lokasmiṃ anayāya sattānaṃ byābādhāya [vadhāya (saṃ. ni.4.230)] pāṇīnaṃ.
segments.ne37:284.3: Santi, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso [gilabaḷiso (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.4.230] mārassa anayaṃ āpanno, byasanaṃ āpanno, yathākāmaṃ karaṇīyo pāpimato.
segments.ne37:285.1: “Santi, bhikkhave, sotaviññeyyā saddā … pe … ghānaviññeyyā gandhā … pe … jivhāviññeyyā rasā … pe … kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā … pe … manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.ne37:285.6: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso mārassa anayaṃ āpanno, byasanaṃ āpanno, yathākāmaṃ karaṇīyo [yathākāmakaraṇīyo (sī.) saṃ. ni.4.230] pāpimato”ti.
segments.ne37:286.1: “Santi ca, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na gilitabaḷiso mārassa, abhedi baḷisaṃ, paribhedi baḷisaṃ, na anayaṃ āpanno, na byasanaṃ āpanno, na yathākāmaṃ karaṇīyo pāpimato.
segments.ne37:287.1: “Santi ca, bhikkhave, sotaviññeyyā saddā … pe … manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā, tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati, nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.ne37:287.3: Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu na gilitabaḷiso mārassa, abhedi baḷisaṃ, paribhedi baḷisaṃ, na anayaṃ āpanno, na byasanaṃ āpanno, na yathākāmaṃ karaṇīyo pāpimato”ti.
segments.ne37:288.1: Tattha katamaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca asekkhabhāgiyañca suttaṃ?
segments.ne37:289.1: “Ayaṃ loko santāpajāto, phassapareto rogaṃ vadati attato [attano (sī. ka.) passa udā.30];
segments.ne37:289.3: Yena yena hi maññati [maññanti (sī. ka.)], tato taṃ hoti aññathā.
segments.ne37:292.1: “Ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā bhavena bhavassa vippamokkhamāhaṃsu, sabbe te ‘avippamuttā bhavasmā’ti vadāmi.
segments.ne37:292.2: Ye vā pana keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā vibhavena bhavassa nissaraṇamāhaṃsu, sabbe te ‘anissaṭā bhavasmā’ti vadāmi.
segments.ne37:292.3: Upadhiṃ [upadhi (sī. ka.) passa udā.30] hi paṭicca dukkhamidaṃ sambhotī”ti.
segments.ne37:294.1: “Lokamimaṃ passa, puthū avijjāya paretā bhūtā bhūtaratā, bhavā aparimuttā, ye hi keci bhavā sabbadhi sabbatthatāya, sabbe te bhavā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā”ti.
segments.ne37:297.1: “Tassa nibbutassa bhikkhuno, anupādā punabbhavo na hoti;
segments.ne37:297.3: Abhibhūto māro vijitasaṅgāmo, upaccagā sabbabhavāni tādī”ti.
segments.ne37:299.3: Anusotagāmī paṭisotagāmī ṭhitatto tiṇṇo pāraṅgato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo”ti.
segments.ne37:299.4: Tattha yoyaṃ puggalo anusotagāmī, ayaṃ puggalo saṃkilesabhāgiyo.
segments.ne37:299.5: Tattha yoyaṃ puggalo paṭisotagāmī yo ca ṭhitatto, ime dve puggalā nibbedhabhāgiyā.
segments.ne37:299.6: Tattha yoyaṃ puggalo tiṇṇo pāraṅgato thale tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo, ayaṃ asekkho.
segments.ne37:300.1: Tattha katamaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca suttaṃ?
segments.ne37:301.1: Chaḷābhijātiko atthi puggalo kaṇho kaṇhābhijātiko kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati, atthi puggalo kaṇho kaṇhābhijātiko sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati, atthi puggalo kaṇho kaṇhābhijātiko akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ accantadiṭṭhaṃ [antaṃ niṭṭhaṃ (sī.)] nibbānaṃ ārādheti, atthi puggalo sukko sukkābhijātiko kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati, atthi puggalo sukko sukkābhijātiko sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati, atthi puggalo sukko sukkābhijātiko akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ accantadiṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādheti.
segments.ne37:302.1: Tattha yo ca puggalo kaṇho kaṇhābhijātiko kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati, yo ca puggalo sukko sukkābhijātiko kaṇhaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati, ime dve puggalā saṃkilesabhāgiyā.
segments.ne37:303.1: Tattha yo ca puggalo kaṇho kaṇhābhijātiko sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati, yo ca puggalo sukko sukkābhijātiko sukkaṃ dhammaṃ abhijāyati, ime dve puggalā vāsanābhāgiyā.
segments.ne37:304.1: Tattha yo ca puggalo kaṇho kaṇhābhijātiko akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ accantadiṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādheti, yo ca puggalo sukko sukkābhijātiko akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ accantadiṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādheti, ime dve puggalā nibbedhabhāgiyā, idaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca suttaṃ.
segments.ne37:305.3: Atthi kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ, atthi kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ, atthi kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ, atthi kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammuttamaṃ kammaseṭṭhaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati”.
segments.ne37:306.1: Tattha yañca kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ, yañca kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ, ayaṃ saṃkileso.
segments.ne37:306.2: Yañca kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ, ayaṃ vāsanā.
segments.ne37:306.3: Yañca kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammuttamaṃ kammaseṭṭhaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati, ayaṃ nibbedho.
segments.ne37:311.1: “Puññāni karitvāna, saggā saggaṃ vajanti katapuññā”ti vāsanā.
segments.ne37:312.3: Yo ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitesu cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ pariccajati, yo ca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitesu sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānan”ti.
segments.ne37:312.4: Tattha yo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitesu cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ pariccajati, ayaṃ vāsanā.
segments.ne37:313.1: Yo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitesu sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ, ayaṃ nibbedho.
segments.ne37:314.1: Tattha taṇhāsaṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ taṇhāpakkheneva niddisitabbaṃ tīhi taṇhāhi – kāmataṇhāya bhavataṇhāya vibhavataṇhāya.
segments.ne37:314.3: Yena yena vā pana vatthunā ajjhositā, tena teneva niddisitabbaṃ, tassā vitthāro chattiṃsataṇhājāliniyāvicaritāni.
segments.ne37:315.1: Tattha diṭṭhisaṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ diṭṭhipakkheneva niddisitabbaṃ ucchedasassatena, yena yena vā pana vatthunā diṭṭhivasena abhinivisati “idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan”ti, tena teneva niddisitabbaṃ, tassā vitthāro dvāsaṭṭhidiṭṭhigatāni.
segments.ne37:316.1: Tattha duccaritasaṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ cetanāya cetasikakammena niddisitabbaṃ tīhi duccaritehi – kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena, tassa vitthāro dasaakusalakammapathā.
segments.ne37:317.1: Tattha taṇhāvodānabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ samathena niddisitabbaṃ, diṭṭhivodānabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ vipassanā niddisitabbaṃ, duccaritavodānabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ sucaritena niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:317.5: Tathā nibbatte saṃsāre kāyaduccaritaṃ kāyasucaritaṃ vacīduccaritaṃ vacīsucaritaṃ manoduccaritaṃ manosucaritaṃ iminā asubhena kammavipākena idaṃ bālalakkhaṇaṃ nibbattatīti.
segments.ne37:318.1: Iminā subhena kammavipākena idaṃ mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ nibbattatīti.
segments.ne37:319.1: Tattha saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ catūhi kilesabhūmīhi niddisitabbaṃ – anusayabhūmiyā pariyuṭṭhānabhūmiyā saṃyojanabhūmiyā upādānabhūmiyā.
segments.ne37:319.3: Sānusayassa pariyuṭṭhānaṃ jāyati, pariyuṭṭhito saṃyujjati, saṃyujjanto upādiyati, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti, evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
segments.ne37:319.4: Imāhi catūhi kilesabhūmīhi sabbe kilesā saṅgahaṃ samosaraṇaṃ gacchanti, idaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ.
segments.ne37:320.1: Vāsanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ tīhi sucaritehi niddisitabbaṃ, nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ catūhi saccehi niddisitabbaṃ, asekkhabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ tīhi dhammehi niddisitabbaṃ – buddhadhammehi paccekabuddhadhammehi sāvakabhūmiyā.
segments.ne37:321.2: Lokiyaṃ lokuttaraṃ lokiyañca lokuttarañca, sattādhiṭṭhānaṃ dhammādhiṭṭhānaṃ sattādhiṭṭhānañca dhammādhiṭṭhānañca, ñāṇaṃ ñeyyaṃ ñāṇañca ñeyyañca, dassanaṃ bhāvanā dassanañca bhāvanā ca, sakavacanaṃ paravacanaṃ sakavacanañca paravacanañca, visajjanīyaṃ avisajjanīyaṃ visajjanīyañca avisajjanīyañca, kammaṃ vipāko kammañca vipāko ca, kusalaṃ akusalaṃ kusalañca akusalañca, anuññātaṃ paṭikkhittaṃ anuññātañca paṭikkhittañca, thavo cāti.
segments.ne37:323.1: “Na hi pāpaṃ kataṃ kammaṃ, sajjukhīraṃva muccati;
segments.ne37:323.3: Ḍahantaṃ [dahantaṃ (sī. ka.) passa dha. pa.71] bālamanveti, bhasmacchannova [bhasmāchannova (ka.)] pāvakoti.
segments.ne37:325.1: “Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, agatigamanāni sabbaṃ … pe … nihīyate tassa yaso kāḷapakkheva candimā”ti.
segments.ne37:326.3: Lābho alābho, yaso ayaso, nindā pasaṃsā, sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ.
segments.ne37:328.3: Pahīnamānassa anāsavassa, devāpi tassa pihayanti tādino”ti.
segments.ne37:332.1: “Laddhāna mānusattaṃ dve, kiccaṃ akiccameva cā”ti dve gāthā.
segments.ne37:332.2: Yaṃ iha “sukiccaṃ ceva puññānī”ti ca “puññāni karitvāna, saggā saggaṃ vajanti katapuññā”ti ca.
segments.ne37:333.1: Yaṃ iha “saṃyojanavippahānaṃ vā”ti ca “saṃyojanappahānā, jarāmaraṇā vippamuccantī”ti ca, idaṃ lokuttaraṃ.
segments.ne37:334.1: “Viññāṇe ce, bhikkhave, āhāre sati nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti, nāmarūpassa avakkantiyā sati punabbhavo hoti, punabbhave sati jāti hoti, jātiyā sati jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
segments.ne37:334.3: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave [passa saṃ. ni.2.55], mahārukkho, tassa yāni ceva mūlāni adhogamāni yāni ca tiriyaṃ gamāni, sabbāni tāni uddhaṃ ojaṃ abhiharanti.
segments.ne37:334.4: Evaṃ hi so, bhikkhave, mahārukkho tadāhāro tadupādāno ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
segments.ne37:334.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, viññāṇe āhāre sati nāmarūpassa avakkanti hoti sabbaṃ … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hotī”ti.
segments.ne37:335.1: “Viññāṇe ce, bhikkhave, āhāre asati nāmarūpassa avakkanti na hoti, nāmarūpassa avakkantiyā asati punabbhavo na hoti, punabbhave asati jāti na hoti, jātiyā asati jarāmaraṇaṃ sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
segments.ne37:335.3: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, mahārukkho atha puriso āgaccheyya kuddālapiṭakaṃ [kudālapiṭakaṃ (ka.)] ādāya, so taṃ rukkhaṃ mūle chindeyya, mūle [mūlaṃ (saṃ. ni.2.55)] chetvā palikhaṇeyya, palikhaṇitvā mūlāni uddhareyya antamaso usīranāḷimattānipi.
segments.ne37:335.4: So taṃ rukkhaṃ khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ chindeyya, khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ chinditvā [chitvā (sī. ka.)] phāleyya, phāletvā sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ kareyya, sakalikaṃ sakalikaṃ karitvā vātātape visoseyya, vātātape visosetvā agginā ḍaheyya, agginā ḍahetvā masiṃ kareyya, masiṃ karitvā mahāvāte vā ophuneyya, nadiyā vā sīghasotāya pavāheyya, evaṃ hi so, bhikkhave, mahārukkho ucchinnamūlo assa tālāvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato [anabhāvaṃgato (sī.)] āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.
segments.ne37:335.5: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, viññāṇe āhāre asati nāmarūpassa avakkanti na hoti, nāmarūpassa avakkantiyā asati sabbaṃ … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hotī”ti.
segments.ne37:337.1: “Sabbā disā anuparigamma cetasā, nevajjhagā piyataramattanā kvaci;
segments.ne37:337.3: Evaṃ piyo puthu attā paresaṃ, tasmā na hiṃse paramattakāmo”ti [paraṃ attakāmoti (sī.) saṃ. ni.1.119; udā.41 passitabbaṃ].
segments.ne37:339.1: “Ye keci bhūtā bhavissanti ye vāpi [ca (sī. ka.) passa udā.42], sabbe gamissanti pahāya dehaṃ;
segments.ne37:339.3: Taṃ sabbajāniṃ kusalo viditvā, ātāpiyo [ātāpī so (sī. ka.) passa udā.42] brahmacariyaṃ careyyā”ti.
segments.ne37:341.1: “Sattahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgataṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ api viveciyamānena paṇāmiyamānena gale pisanamajjamānena [galepi pamajjamānena (sī.)] yāvajīvaṃ na vijahitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:341.3: Piyo ca hoti manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo ca vattā ca vacanakkhamo ca gambhīrañca kathaṃ kattā hoti, no ca aṭṭhāne [na ca aṭṭhāne (sī. ka.) passa a. ni.7.37] niyojeti.
segments.ne37:341.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, sattahi … pe … na vijahitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:342.3: Gambhīrañca kathaṃ kattā, na caṭṭhāne niyojako;
segments.ne37:345.3: Taṇhakkhayasukhassete [taṇhakkhayā sukhassete (sī.) passa udā.12], kalaṃ nāgghanti soḷasin”ti.
segments.ne37:347.3: Asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, yattha dukkhaṃ nirujjhatī”ti.
segments.ne37:350.1: “Mātaraṃ pitaraṃ hantvā, rājāno dve ca khattiye;
segments.ne37:356.1: So kāyepi cittaṃ samodahati, cittepi kāyaṃ samodahati, kāye sukhasaññañca lahusaññañca okkamitvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.ne37:358.1: “Yaṃ taṃ lokuttaraṃ ñāṇaṃ, sabbaññū yena vuccati;
segments.ne37:363.1: “Kittayissāmi te [vo (sī. ka.) passa su. ni.1072] santiṃ,[dhotakāti bhagavā,]
segments.ne37:363.4: Yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
segments.ne37:364.3: Yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
segments.ne37:367.1: “Catunnaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasaccānaṃ ananubodhā appaṭivedhā evamidaṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ mamañceva tumhākañca … pe … tayidaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, dukkhasamudayaṃ [dukkhasamudayo (sī. ka.) passa dī. ni.2.155] ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, dukkhanirodhaṃ [dukkhanirodho (sī. ka.)] ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ anubuddhaṃ paṭividdhaṃ.
segments.ne37:367.3: Ucchinnā bhavataṇhā, khīṇā bhavanetti, natthi dāni punabbhavo”ti.
segments.ne37:367.4: Idamavoca bhagavā, idaṃ vatvāna sugato, athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.ne37:369.3: Ucchinnaṃ mūlaṃ dukkhassa, natthi dāni punabbhavo”ti.
segments.ne37:371.2: Rūpaṃ aniccaṃ, vedanā aniccā, saññā aniccā, saṅkhārā aniccā, viññāṇaṃ aniccanti.
segments.ne37:372.1: Evaṃ jānaṃ evaṃ passaṃ ariyasāvako “rūpaṃ aniccan”ti passati,“vedanā aniccā”ti passati,“saññaṃ … pe … saṅkhāre … pe … viññāṇaṃ aniccan”ti passatīti.
segments.ne37:373.1: So parimuccati rūpena, parimuccati vedanāya, parimuccati saññāya, parimuccati saṅkhārehi, parimuccati viññāṇamhā, parimuccati dukkhasmāti vadāmīti.
segments.ne37:374.3: “Atha nibbindati dukkhe esa maggo visuddhiyā”ti idaṃ ñāṇañca ñeyyañca.
segments.ne37:375.3: “Atha nibbindati dukkhe esa maggo visuddhiyā”ti idaṃ ñāṇañca ñeyyañca.
segments.ne37:376.3: “Atha nibbindati dukkhe esa maggo visuddhiyā”ti idaṃ ñāṇañca ñeyyañca.
segments.ne37:377.1: “Ye hi keci, soṇa [passa saṃ. ni.3.49], samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā aniccena rūpena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena ‘seyyohamasmī’ti vā samanupassanti,‘sadisohamasmī’ti vā samanupassanti,‘hīnohamasmī’ti vā samanupassanti.
segments.ne37:377.3: Aniccāya vedanāya … pe … aniccāya saññāya … pe … aniccehi saṅkhārehi … pe … aniccena viññāṇena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena ‘seyyohamasmī’ti vā samanupassanti,‘sadisohamasmī’ti vā samanupassanti,‘hīnohamasmī’ti vā samanupassanti, kimaññatra yathābhūtassa adassanā”ti.
segments.ne37:378.1: “Ye ca kho keci, soṇa, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā aniccena rūpena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena ‘seyyohamasmī’ tipi na samanupassanti,‘sadisohamasmī’ tipi na samanupassanti,‘hīnohamasmī’ tipi na samanupassanti, kimaññatra yathābhūtassa dassanā.
segments.ne37:378.2: Aniccāya vedanāya … pe … aniccāya saññāya … pe … aniccehi saṅkhārehi … pe … aniccena viññāṇena dukkhena vipariṇāmadhammena ‘seyyohamasmī’ tipi na samanupassanti,‘sadisohamasmī’ tipi na samanupassanti,‘hīnohamasmī’ tipi na samanupassanti, kimaññatra yathābhūtassa dassanāti.
segments.ne37:381.3: Kiñcāpi te honti bhusaṃ pamattā [bhusappamattā (sī.) passa khu. pā.609], na te bhavaṃ aṭṭhamamādiyantī”ti.
segments.ne37:383.3: Tathūpamaṃ sappurisaṃ vadāmi, yo ariyasaccāni avecca passatī”ti.
segments.ne37:385.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya ‘khīṇanirayomhi, khīṇatiracchānayoni, khīṇapettivisayo, khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo, sattakkhattuparamaṃ [sattakkhattuparamo (sī.)] deve ca manusse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī’ti.
segments.ne37:385.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvakassa tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā patiṭṭhitā virūḷhā mūlajātā asaṃhāriyā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ saha dhammena, dhamme kho pana niṭṭhaṃ gato hoti, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhi, yadidaṃ madanimmadano … pe … nirodho nibbānaṃ, saha dhammiyā kho panassa honti iṭṭhā kantā piyā manāpā gihī ceva pabbajitā ca.
segments.ne37:385.5: Ariyakantehi kho pana sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi acchiddehi asabalehi akammāsehi bhujissehi viññuppasaṭṭhehi aparāmaṭṭhehi samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.ne37:385.6: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato ariyasāvako ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ byākareyya ‘khīṇanirayomhi, khīṇatiracchānayoni, khīṇapettivisayo, khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo, sattakkhattuparamaṃ deve ca manusse ca sandhāvitvā saṃsaritvā dukkhassantaṃ karissāmī’”ti.
segments.ne37:388.1: “Yassindriyāni bhāvitāni [subhāvitāni (sī. ka.) passa su. ni.512], ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca sabbaloke;
segments.ne37:388.3: Nibbijjha imaṃ parañca lokaṃ, kālaṃ kaṅkhati bhāvito sadanto”ti.
segments.ne37:390.3: Anabhijjhā dhammapadaṃ, abyāpādo dhammapadaṃ, sammāsati dhammapadaṃ, sammāsamādhi dhammapadaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri dhammapadānī”ti.
segments.ne37:391.4: Pañca saṅgātigo bhikkhu, oghatiṇṇoti vuccatī”ti ayaṃ bhāvanā.
segments.ne37:392.4: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu anabhisametassa dukkhassa ariyasaccassa abhisamayāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, anabhisametassa dukkhasamudayassa ariyasaccassa … pe … dukkhanirodhassa … pe … dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ariyasaccassa abhisamayāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
segments.ne37:393.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,‘ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodho’ti … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
segments.ne37:394.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
segments.ne37:399.1: “Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni bālanimittāni bālāpadānāni, yehi bālaṃ bāloti pare sañjānanti.
segments.ne37:399.3: Bālo, bhikkhave, duccintitacintī ca hoti, dubbhāsitabhāsī ca hoti, dukkaṭakammakārī [dukkatakammakārī (sī.) ma. ni.3.246; a. ni.3.3 passitabbaṃ] ca hoti.
segments.ne37:399.4: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi bālassa bālalakkhaṇāni bālanimittāni bālāpadānāni.
segments.ne37:400.1: “Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍitāpadānāni, yehi paṇḍitaṃ paṇḍitoti pare sañjānanti.
segments.ne37:400.3: Paṇḍito, bhikkhave, sucintitacintī ca hoti, subhāsitabhāsī ca hoti, sukatakammakārī ca hoti.
segments.ne37:400.4: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, tīṇi paṇḍitassa paṇḍitalakkhaṇāni paṇḍitanimittāni paṇḍitāpadānānī”ti.
segments.ne37:403.1: “Pathavīsamo natthi vitthato, ninno pātālasamo na vijjati;
segments.ne37:403.3: Merusamo natthi unnato, cakkavattisadiso natthi poriso”ti.
segments.ne37:405.4: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.ne37:406.1: “Bhiyyo bālā pabhijjeyyuṃ [pakujjheyyuṃ (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.251], no cassa paṭisedhako;
segments.ne37:406.3: Tasmā bhusena daṇḍena, dhīro bālaṃ nisedhaye”ti.
segments.ne37:407.1: “Bhāsitāya kho pana, bhikkhave, vepacittinā asurindena gāthāya asurā anumodiṃsu, devā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.ne37:407.2: Atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca ‘bhaṇa, devānaminda, gāthan’ti.
segments.ne37:407.4: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.ne37:408.3: Paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammatī”ti.
segments.ne37:409.1: “Bhāsitāya kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkena devānamindena gāthāya devā anumodiṃsu, asurā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.ne37:409.2: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo vepacittiṃ asurindaṃ etadavoca ‘bhaṇa, vepacitti, gāthan’ti.
segments.ne37:409.4: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, vepacitti asurindo imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.ne37:410.3: Yadā naṃ maññati [maññatī (sī.) passa saṃ. ni.1.251] bālo, bhayā myāyaṃ titikkhati;
segments.ne37:411.1: “Bhāsitāya kho pana, bhikkhave, vepacittinā asurindena gāthāya asurā anumodiṃsu, devā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
segments.ne37:411.2: Atha kho vepacitti asurindo sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ etadavoca ‘bhaṇa, devānaminda, gāthan’ti.
segments.ne37:411.4: Evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.ne37:412.1: “Kāmaṃ maññatu vā mā vā, bhayā myāyaṃ titikkhati;
segments.ne37:412.3: Sadatthaparamā atthā, khantā bhiyyo na vijjati.
segments.ne37:413.3: Tamāhu paramaṃ khantiṃ, niccaṃ khamati dubbalo.
segments.ne37:414.1: “Abalaṃ taṃ balaṃ āhu, yassa bālabalaṃ balaṃ;
segments.ne37:416.3: Paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammati.
segments.ne37:417.3: Janā maññanti bāloti, ye dhammassa akovidā”ti.
segments.ne37:418.1: “Bhāsitāsu kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkena devānamindena gāthāsu devā anumodiṃsu, asurā tuṇhī ahesun”ti.
segments.ne37:420.1: Yañca pattaṃ yañca pattabbaṃ ubhayametaṃ rajānukiṇṇaṃ āturassānusikkhato.
segments.ne37:420.2: Ye ca sikkhāsārā sīlaṃ vataṃ jīvitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ upaṭṭhānasārā, ayameko anto.
segments.ne37:420.3: Ye ca evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino “natthi kāmesu doso”ti, ayaṃ dutiyo anto.
segments.ne37:420.4: Iccete ubho antā kaṭasivaḍḍhanā kaṭasiyo diṭṭhiṃ vaḍḍhenti.
segments.ne37:420.5: Ete ubho ante anabhiññāya olīyanti eke atidhāvanti eketi.
segments.ne37:421.1: Ye ca kho te ubho ante abhiññāya tatra ca na ahesuṃ, tena ca amaññiṃsu, vaṭṭaṃ tesaṃ natthi paññāpanāyāti.
segments.ne37:422.1: Rājā pasenadi [passenadi (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.113] kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca – idha mayhaṃ, bhante, rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi “kesaṃ nu kho piyo attā, kesaṃ appiyo attā”ti.
segments.ne37:422.3: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, etadahosi “ye ca kho keci kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti, tesaṃ appiyo attā.
segments.ne37:422.5: Kiñcāpi te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ ‘piyo no attā’ti, atha kho tesaṃ appiyo attā.
segments.ne37:422.7: Yaṃ hi appiyo appiyassa kareyya, taṃ te attanāva attano karonti, tasmā tesaṃ appiyo attā.
segments.ne37:422.8: Ye ca kho keci kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, tesaṃ piyo attā.
segments.ne37:422.9: Kiñcāpi te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ ‘appiyo no attā’ti, atha kho tesaṃ piyo attā.
segments.ne37:423.1: “Evametaṃ, mahārāja, evametaṃ, mahārāja, ye hi keci, mahārāja, kāyena duccaritaṃ caranti, vācāya duccaritaṃ caranti, manasā duccaritaṃ caranti tasmā tesaṃ appiyo attā.
segments.ne37:423.2: Kiñcāpi te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ ‘piyo no attā’ti, atha kho tesaṃ appiyo attā.
segments.ne37:423.4: Yaṃ hi, mahārāja, appiyo appiyassa kareyya, taṃ te attanāva attano karonti, tasmā tesaṃ appiyo attā.
segments.ne37:423.5: Ye ca kho keci mahārāja kāyena sucaritaṃ caranti, vācāya sucaritaṃ caranti, manasā sucaritaṃ caranti, tesaṃ piyo attā.
segments.ne37:423.6: Kiñcāpi te evaṃ vadeyyuṃ ‘appiyo no attā’ti, atha kho tesaṃ piyo attā.
segments.ne37:423.8: Yaṃ hi, mahārāja, piyo piyassa kareyya, taṃ te attanāva attano karonti, tasmā tesaṃ piyo attāti.
segments.ne37:424.1: “Attānañce piyaṃ jaññā, na naṃ pāpena saṃyuje;
segments.ne37:424.3: Na hi taṃ sulabhaṃ hoti, sukhaṃ dukkaṭakārinā.
segments.ne37:425.1: “Antakenādhipannassa [maraṇenābhibhūtassa (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.115], jahato mānusaṃ bhavaṃ;
segments.ne37:425.3: Kiṃ hi tassa sakaṃ hoti, kiñca ādāya gacchati;
segments.ne37:426.1: “Ubho puññañca pāpañca, yaṃ macco kurute idha;
segments.ne37:426.3: Tañhi tassa sakaṃ hoti, taṃva ādāya gacchati;
segments.ne37:430.1: Pañhe pucchite idaṃ abhiññeyyaṃ, idaṃ pariññeyyaṃ, idaṃ pahātabbaṃ, idaṃ bhāvetabbaṃ, idaṃ sacchikātabbaṃ, ime dhammā evaṃgahitā idaṃ phalaṃ nibbattayanti.
segments.ne37:430.2: Tesaṃ evaṃgahitānaṃ ayamattho iti idaṃ visajjanīyaṃ.
segments.ne37:430.3: “Uḷāro buddho bhagavā”ti buddhauḷārataṃ dhammasvākkhātataṃ saṅghasuppaṭipattiñca ekaṃseneva niddise.
segments.ne37:430.4: “Sabbe saṅkhārā aniccā”ti “sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā”ti “sabbe dhammā anattā”ti ekaṃseneva niddise.
segments.ne37:432.1: “Ākaṅkhato te naradammasārathi [naradammasārathī (sī.)], devā manussā manasā vicintitaṃ;
segments.ne37:432.3: Sabbe na jaññā kasiṇāpi pāṇino, santaṃ samādhiṃ araṇaṃ nisevato;
segments.ne37:434.1: Ettako bhagavā sīlakkhandhe samādhikkhandhe paññākkhandhe vimuttikkhandhe vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhe iriyāyaṃ pabhāve hitesitāyaṃ karuṇāyaṃ iddhiyanti.
segments.ne37:435.1: “Tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa loke uppādā tiṇṇaṃ ratanānaṃ uppādo buddharatanassa dhammaratanassa saṅgharatanassa”.
segments.ne37:436.3: “Pubbā, bhikkhave, koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sakiṃ nirayaṃ sakiṃ tiracchānayoniṃ sakiṃ pettivisayaṃ sakiṃ asurayoniṃ sakiṃ deve sakiṃ manusse sandhāvitaṃ saṃsaritaṃ”.
segments.ne37:436.6: Duvidhā buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ desanā attūpanāyikā ca parūpanāyikā ca.
segments.ne37:436.9: Yathā bhagavā kokālikaṃ bhikkhuṃ ārabbha aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ evamāha –
segments.ne37:437.1: “Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsatikhāriko kosalako tilavāho … pe … na tveva eko abbudo nirayo.
segments.ne37:437.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhu, vīsati abbudā nirayā, evameko nirabbudo nirayo [nirabbudanirayo (saṃ. ni.1.181)].
segments.ne37:437.4: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati nirabbudā nirayā, evameko ababo nirayo.
segments.ne37:437.5: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati ababā nirayā, evameko aṭaṭo nirayo.
segments.ne37:437.6: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati aṭaṭā nirayā, evameko ahaho nirayo.
segments.ne37:437.7: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati ahahā nirayā, evameko kumudo nirayo.
segments.ne37:437.8: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati kumudā nirayā, evameko sogandhiko nirayo.
segments.ne37:437.9: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati sogandhikā nirayā, evameko uppalako nirayo [uppalanirayo (saṃ. ni.1.181)].
segments.ne37:437.10: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati uppalakā nirayā, evameko puṇḍarīko nirayo.
segments.ne37:437.11: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhu, vīsati puṇḍarīkā nirayā, evameko padumo nirayo.
segments.ne37:437.12: Padume pana, bhikkhu, niraye kokāliko bhikkhu upapanno sāriputtamoggallānesu cittaṃ āghātetvā”ti.
segments.ne37:437.13: Yaṃ vā pana kiñci bhagavā āha “ayaṃ appameyyo asaṅkhyeyo”ti.
segments.ne37:438.1: Tattha katamaṃ visajjanīyañca avisajjanīyañca, yadā so upako ājīvako bhagavantaṃ āha “kuhiṃ, āvuso gotama, gamissasī”ti.
segments.ne37:440.1: Upako ājīvako āha “‘jino’ti kho āvuso, bho gotama, paṭijānāsī”ti.
segments.ne37:441.1: “Mādisā ve jinā [jinā ve mādisā (sī. ka.) passa ma. ni.2.341] honti, ye pattā āsavakkhayaṃ;
segments.ne37:441.3: Jitā me pāpakā dhammā, tasmāhaṃ upakā jino”ti.
segments.ne37:442.3: Katamo āsavakkhayo, rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayoti visajjanīyaṃ.
segments.ne37:443.7: Evaṃ atthi vedanā … pe … saññā … pe … saṅkhārā … pe … atthi viññāṇanti visajjanīyaṃ.
segments.ne37:443.16: Aññatra vedanāya … pe … saññāya … pe … saṅkhārehi … pe … viññāṇena tathāgatoti avisajjanīyaṃ.
segments.ne37:443.20: Ayaṃ so tathāgato arūpako … pe … avedanako … pe … asaññako … pe … asaṅkhārako … pe … aviññāṇakoti avisajjanīyaṃ.
segments.ne37:444.1: Passati bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte cavamāne upapajjamāne evaṃ sabbaṃ … pe … yathākammūpage satte pajānātīti visajjanīyaṃ.
segments.ne37:447.3: Kiṃ hi tassa sakaṃ hoti, kiñca ādāya gacchati;
segments.ne37:448.1: “Ubho puññañca pāpañca, yaṃ macco kurute idha;
segments.ne37:448.3: Tañhi tassa sakaṃ hoti, taṃva [tañca (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.115] ādāya gacchati;
segments.ne37:450.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bālaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāyaṃ [chamāya (sī. ka.) passa ma. ni.3.248] vā semānaṃ yānissa pubbe pāpakāni kammāni katāni kāyena duccaritāni vācāya duccaritāni manasā duccaritāni, tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti ajjholambanti abhippalambanti.
segments.ne37:450.2: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, mahataṃ pabbatakūṭānaṃ chāyā sāyanhasamayaṃ pathaviyaṃ olambanti ajjholambanti abhippalambanti.
segments.ne37:450.3: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, bālaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāyaṃ vā semānaṃ yānissa pubbe pāpakāni kammāni katāni kāyena duccaritāni vācāya duccaritāni manasā duccaritāni, tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti ajjholambanti abhippalambanti.
segments.ne37:450.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, bālassa evaṃ hoti ‘akataṃ vata me kalyāṇaṃ, akataṃ kusalaṃ, akataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ.
segments.ne37:450.5: Kataṃ pāpaṃ, kataṃ luddaṃ, kataṃ kibbisaṃ, yāvatā bho akatakalyāṇānaṃ akatakusalānaṃ akatabhīruttāṇānaṃ katapāpānaṃ kataluddānaṃ katakibbisānaṃ gati, taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmī’ti, so socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjatī”ti.
segments.ne37:451.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, paṇḍitaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāyaṃ vā semānaṃ yānissa pubbe kalyāṇāni kammāni katāni kāyena sucaritāni vācāya sucaritāni manasā sucaritāni, tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti ajjholambanti abhippalambanti.
segments.ne37:451.2: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, mahataṃ pabbatakūṭānaṃ chāyā sāyanhasamayaṃ pathaviyaṃ olambanti ajjholambanti abhippalambanti.
segments.ne37:451.3: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, paṇḍitaṃ pīṭhasamārūḷhaṃ vā mañcasamārūḷhaṃ vā chamāyaṃ vā semānaṃ yānissa pubbe kalyāṇāni kammāni katāni kāyena sucaritāni vācāya sucaritāni manasā sucaritāni, tānissa tamhi samaye olambanti ajjholambanti abhippalambanti.
segments.ne37:451.4: Tatra, bhikkhave, paṇḍitassa ‘evaṃ hoti akataṃ vata me pāpaṃ, akataṃ luddaṃ, akataṃ kibbisaṃ.
segments.ne37:451.5: Kataṃ kalyāṇaṃ, kataṃ kusalaṃ, kataṃ bhīruttāṇaṃ, yāvatā bho akatapāpānaṃ akataluddānaṃ akatakibbisānaṃ katakalyāṇānaṃ katakusalānaṃ katabhīruttāṇānaṃ gati, taṃ gatiṃ pecca gacchāmī’ti, so na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati,‘kataṃ me puññaṃ, akataṃ pāpaṃ, yā bhavissati gati akatapāpassa akataluddassa akatakibbisassa katapuññassa katakusalassa katabhīruttāṇassa, taṃ pecca bhave gatiṃ paccanubhavissāmī’ti vippaṭisāro na jāyati.
segments.ne37:451.6: Avippaṭisārino kho, bhikkhave, itthiyā vā purisassa vā gihino vā pabbajitassa vā bhaddakaṃ maraṇaṃ bhaddikā kālaṅkiriyāti vadāmī”ti.
segments.ne37:454.1: “Lābhā vo, bhikkhave, suladdhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, khaṇo vo, bhikkhave, paṭiladdho brahmacariyavāsāya.
segments.ne37:454.2: Diṭṭhā mayā, bhikkhave, cha phassāyatanikā nāma nirayā.
segments.ne37:454.3: Tattha yaṃ kiñci cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati aniṭṭharūpaṃyeva passati, no iṭṭharūpaṃ.
segments.ne37:455.1: Yaṃ kiñci sotena saddaṃ suṇāti … pe … ghānena … pe … jivhāya … pe … kāyena … pe … yaṃ kiñci manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti aniṭṭhadhammaṃyeva vijānāti, no iṭṭhadhammaṃ.
segments.ne37:455.8: Lābhā vo, bhikkhave, suladdhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, khaṇo vo, bhikkhave, paṭiladdho brahmacariyavāsāya.
segments.ne37:456.1: “Diṭṭhā mayā, bhikkhave, cha phassāyatanikā nāma saggā.
segments.ne37:456.2: Tattha yaṃ kiñci cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati iṭṭharūpaṃyeva passati, no aniṭṭharūpaṃ.
segments.ne37:456.5: Yaṃ kiñci sotena saddaṃ suṇāti … pe … ghānena … pe … jivhāya … pe … kāyena … pe … manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti iṭṭhadhammaṃyeva vijānāti, no aniṭṭhadhammaṃ.
segments.ne37:456.12: Lābhā vo, bhikkhave, suladdhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, khaṇo vo, bhikkhave, paṭiladdho brahmacariyavāsāyā”ti.
segments.ne37:457.3: Niraye paccamānānaṃ [paccamānassa (ka.) passa pe. va.802], kadā anto bhavissati.
segments.ne37:458.1: “Natthi anto kuto anto, na anto paṭidissati [patidissati (sī.) jā.1.4.55];
segments.ne37:458.3: Tadā hi pakataṃ pāpaṃ, tuyhaṃ mayhañca mārisā”ti.
segments.ne37:461.1: “Adhammacārī hi naro pamatto, yahiṃ yahiṃ gacchati duggatiṃ yo;
segments.ne37:461.3: So naṃ adhammo carito hanāti, sayaṃ gahīto yathā kaṇhasappo.
segments.ne37:462.1: “Na hi [passa theragā.304] dhammo adhammo ca, ubho samavipākino;
segments.ne37:462.3: Adhammo nirayaṃ neti, dhammo pāpeti suggatin”ti.
segments.ne37:464.1: “Mā, bhikkhave, puññānaṃ bhāyittha, sukhassetaṃ, bhikkhave, adhivacanaṃ iṭṭhassa kantassa piyassa manāpassa yadidaṃ puññāni.
segments.ne37:464.2: Abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, dīgharattaṃ katānaṃ puññānaṃ iṭṭhaṃ [dīgharattaṃ iṭṭhaṃ (sī. ka.) passa itivu.22] kantaṃ piyaṃ manāpaṃ vipākaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ, satta vassāni mettacittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na imaṃ [na yimaṃ (itivu.22)] lokaṃ punarāgamāsiṃ.
segments.ne37:464.3: Saṃvaṭṭamāne sudāhaṃ, bhikkhave, kappe ābhassarūpago homi.
segments.ne37:464.5: Tatra sudāhaṃ [sudaṃ (itivu.22)], bhikkhave, brahmā homi mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto aññadatthudaso vasavattī.
segments.ne37:464.6: Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ kho panāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sakko ahosiṃ devānamindo, anekasatakkhattuṃ rājā ahosiṃ cakkavattī [cakkavatti (ka.)] dhammiko dhammarājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto sattaratanasamannāgato, ko pana vādo padesarajjassa?
segments.ne37:464.7: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi ‘kissa nu kho me idaṃ kammassa phalaṃ, kissa kammassa vipāko, yenāhaṃ etarahi evaṃmahiddhiko evaṃmahānubhāvo’ti.
segments.ne37:464.9: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi ‘tiṇṇaṃ kho me idaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ kammānaṃ vipāko.
segments.ne37:464.14: Tattha yañca dānaṃ yo ca damo yo ca saṃyamo, idaṃ kammaṃ.
segments.ne37:464.15: Yo tappaccayā vipāko paccanubhūto, ayaṃ vipāko.
segments.ne37:465.2: Tattha ye dhammā appāyukadīghāyukatāya saṃvattanti bahvābādhaappābādhatāya appesakkhamahesakkhatāya dubbaṇṇasuvaṇṇatāya nīcakulikauccakulikatāya appabhogamahābhogatāya duppaññapaññavantatāya ca saṃvattanti, idaṃ kammaṃ.
segments.ne37:465.3: Yā tattha appāyukadīghāyukatā … pe … duppaññapaññavantatā, ayaṃ vipāko.
segments.ne37:467.1: “Vācānurakkhī manasā susaṃvuto, kāyena ca nākusalaṃ kayirā [akusalaṃ na kayirā (sī.) passa dha. pa.281];
segments.ne37:467.3: Ete tayo kammapathe visodhaye, ārādhaye maggamisippaveditan”ti.
segments.ne37:469.3: Saṃvutaṃ tīhi ṭhānehi, tamahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇan”ti.
segments.ne37:471.3: Alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ, amoho kusalamūlaṃ.
segments.ne37:471.6: “Vijjā, bhikkhave [vijjā ca kho bhikkhave (saṃyuttanikāye)], pubbaṅgamā kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā anudeva [anvadeva (sī. ka.), syādikaṇḍe (moggallāne)11 suttaṃ passitabbaṃ] hirī ottappañcā”ti.
segments.ne37:473.3: Karoti so tathattānaṃ, yathā naṃ icchatī diso”ti.
segments.ne37:475.3: Abhimatthati [abhimanthati (sī.) passa dha. pa.161] dummedhaṃ, vajiraṃvasmamayaṃ maṇin”ti.
segments.ne37:477.3: Garahā ca bhavanti devate, bālamatī nirayesu paccare”ti.
segments.ne37:479.1: “Tīṇimāni, bhikkhave, akusalamūlāni [passa a. ni.3.70], katamāni tīṇi?
segments.ne37:479.2: Lobho akusalamūlaṃ, doso akusalamūlaṃ, moho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.ne37:481.1: “Yādisaṃ [saṃ. ni.1.256] vapate bījaṃ, tādisaṃ harate phalaṃ;
segments.ne37:482.1: Tattha yaṃ āha “kalyāṇakārī kalyāṇan”ti, idaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.ne37:482.3: Yaṃ āha “pāpakārī ca pāpakan”ti, idaṃ akusalaṃ.
segments.ne37:483.1: “Subhena kammena vajanti suggatiṃ, apāyabhūmiṃ asubhena kammunā;
segments.ne37:483.3: Khayā ca kammassa vimuttacetaso, nibbanti te jotirivindhanakkhayā”.
segments.ne37:484.1: Tattha yaṃ āha “subhena kammena vajanti suggatin”ti, idaṃ kusalaṃ.
segments.ne37:484.3: Yaṃ āha “apāyabhūmiṃ asubhena kammunā”ti, idaṃ akusalaṃ.
segments.ne37:486.1: “Yathāpi bhamaro pupphaṃ, vaṇṇagandhamaheṭhayaṃ [vaṇṇagandhaṃ aheṭhayaṃ (sī.) passa dha. pa.49];
segments.ne37:486.3: Paleti [paḷeti (ka.)] rasamādāya, evaṃ gāme munī care”ti.
segments.ne37:488.2: Katamāni tīṇi, idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu, kāyakammavacīkammena samannāgato kusalena parisuddhājīvo.
segments.ne37:488.4: Āraddhavīriyo kho pana hoti thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanāya sacchikiriyāya.
segments.ne37:488.5: Paññavā kho pana hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
segments.ne37:488.6: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ tīṇi karaṇīyānī”ti.
segments.ne37:489.1: “Dasayime [dasa ime (sī. ka.) passa a. ni.10.48], bhikkhave, dhammā pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbā.
segments.ne37:489.3: ‘Vevaṇṇiyamhi ajjhupagato’ti pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbaṃ … pe … ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhammā pabbajitena abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbā”ti.
segments.ne37:492.1: “Natthi puttasamaṃ pemaṃ, natthi gosamitaṃ [goṇasamaṃ (ka.) passa saṃ. ni.1.13] dhanaṃ;
segments.ne37:498.1: “Kiṃsūdha bhītā janatā anekā, maggo canekāyatano pavutto [canekāyatanappavuttā (saṃ. ni.1.75)];
segments.ne37:498.3: Pucchāmi taṃ gotama bhūripañña, kismiṃ ṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāyeti.
segments.ne37:499.1: “Vācaṃ manañca paṇidhāya sammā, kāyena pāpāni akubbamāno;
segments.ne37:499.3: Bahvannapānaṃ gharamāvasanto, saddho mudū saṃvibhāgī vadaññū;
segments.ne37:499.5: Etesu dhammesu ṭhito catūsu, dhamme ṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāye”ti.
segments.ne37:500.1: Tattha yaṃ āha “vācaṃ manañca paṇidhāya sammā”ti, idaṃ anuññātaṃ.
segments.ne37:500.5: Etesu dhammesu ṭhito catūsu, dhamme ṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāye”ti, idaṃ anuññātaṃ.
segments.ne37:502.1: Tattha yaṃ āha “sabbapāpassa akaraṇan”ti, idaṃ paṭikkhittaṃ, yaṃ āha “kusalassa upasampadā”ti, idaṃ anuññātaṃ.
segments.ne37:503.2: Vacīsamācārampāhaṃ, devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampi.
segments.ne37:503.3: Manosamācārampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi … pe … pariyesanampāhaṃ, devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampi”.
segments.ne37:504.1: “Kāyasamācārampāhaṃ, devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī”ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.ne37:504.2: Yathārūpañca kho kāyasamācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpo kāyasamācāro na sevitabbo.
segments.ne37:504.3: Tattha yaṃ jaññā kāyasamācāraṃ “imaṃ [idaṃ (ka.) passa dī. ni.2.364] kho me kāyasamācāraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī”ti, evarūpo kāyasamācāro sevitabbo.
segments.ne37:504.4: “Kāyasamācārampāhaṃ devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī”ti iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.ne37:505.1: “Vacīsamācāraṃ … pe …“pariyesanampāhaṃ, devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī”ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.ne37:505.3: Yathārūpañca kho pariyesanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpā pariyesanā na sevitabbā.
segments.ne37:505.4: Tattha yaṃ jaññā pariyesanaṃ “imaṃ kho me pariyesanaṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī”ti, evarūpā pariyesanā sevitabbā.
segments.ne37:506.1: “Pariyesanampāhaṃ, devānaminda, duvidhena vadāmi sevitabbampi asevitabbampī”ti iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.ne37:509.1: “Maggānaṭṭhaṅgiko [passa dha. pa.273] seṭṭho, saccānaṃ caturo padā;
segments.ne37:511.3: Yāvatā, bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā nevasaññīnāsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati seṭṭhamakkhāyati pavaramakkhāyati, yadidaṃ arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
segments.ne37:511.4: Yāvatā, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ [a. ni.4.34; itivu.81 passitabbaṃ] paṇṇattisaṅkhatānaṃ vā asaṅkhatānaṃ vā, virāgo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyati seṭṭhamakkhāyati pavaramakkhāyati, yadidaṃ madanimmadano … pe … nirodho nibbānaṃ.
segments.ne37:511.6: Yāvatā, bhikkhave, saṅghānaṃ paṇṇatti gaṇānaṃ paṇṇatti mahājanasannipātānaṃ paṇṇatti, tathāgatasāvakasaṅgho tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati seṭṭhamakkhāyati pavaramakkhāyati, yadidaṃ cattāri purisayugāni aṭṭha purisapuggalā … pe … puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
segments.ne37:512.3: Gaṇo ca narasīhassa, tāni tīṇi vississare.
segments.ne37:513.3: Naravaradamako ca cakkhumā, tāni tīṇi lokassa uttari.
segments.ne37:514.1: “Satthā ca appaṭisamo, dhammo ca sabbo nirupadāho;
segments.ne37:514.3: Ariyo ca gaṇavaro, tāni khalu vississare tīṇi.
segments.ne37:515.1: “Saccanāmo jino khemo sabbābhibhū, saccadhammo natthañño tassa uttari;
segments.ne37:515.3: Ariyasaṅgho niccaṃ viññūnaṃ pūjito, tāni tīṇi lokassa uttari.
segments.ne37:516.3: Etena maggena tariṃsu pubbe, tarissanti ye ca [ye cāpi (sī. ka.) passa saṃ. ni.5.384] taranti oghaṃ.
segments.ne37:519.1: Tattha lokiyaṃ suttaṃ dvīhi suttehi niddisitabbaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyena ca vāsanābhāgiyena ca.
segments.ne37:519.2: Lokuttaraṃpi suttaṃ tīhi suttehi niddisitabbaṃ dassanabhāgiyena ca bhāvanābhāgiyena ca asekkhabhāgiyena ca.
segments.ne37:519.4: Yasmiṃ sutte yaṃ yaṃ padaṃ dissati saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ vā vāsanābhāgiyaṃ vā, tena tena lokiyanti niddisitabbaṃ, dassanabhāgiyaṃ vā bhāvanābhāgiyaṃ vā asekkhabhāgiyaṃ vā yaṃ yaṃ padaṃ dissati tena tena lokuttaranti niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:520.1: Vāsanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyassa suttassa nigghātāya, dassanabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ vāsanābhāgiyassa suttassa nigghātāya, bhāvanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ dassanabhāgiyassa suttassa paṭinissaggāya, asekkhabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ bhāvanābhāgiyassa suttassa paṭinissaggāya, asekkhabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāratthaṃ.
segments.ne37:521.1: Lokuttaraṃ suttaṃ sattādhiṭṭhānaṃ chabbīsatiyā puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ, te tīhi suttehi samanvesitabbā dassanabhāgiyena bhāvanābhāgiyena asekkhabhāgiyena cāti.
segments.ne37:522.1: Tattha dassanabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ pañcahi puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ ekabījinā kolaṃkolena sattakkhattuparamena saddhānusārinā dhammānusārinā cāti, dassanabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ imehi pañcahi puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:522.2: Bhāvanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ dvādasahi puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena, sakadāgāminā, anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipannena, anāgāminā, antarā parinibbāyinā, upahacca parinibbāyinā, asaṅkhāraparinibbāyinā, sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyinā, uddhaṃsotena akaniṭṭhagāminā, saddhāvimuttena, diṭṭhippattena, kāyasakkhinā cāti, bhāvanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ imehi dvādasahi puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:522.3: Asekkhabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ navahi puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ saddhāvimuttena, paññāvimuttena, suññatavimuttena, animittavimuttena, appaṇihitavimuttena, ubhatobhāgavimuttena samasīsinā paccekabuddhasammāsambuddhehi cāti, asekkhabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ imehi navahi puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:522.4: Evaṃ lokuttaraṃ suttaṃ sattādhiṭṭhānaṃ imehi chabbīsatiyā puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:523.1: Lokiyaṃ suttaṃ sattādhiṭṭhānaṃ ekūnavīsatiyā puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:523.2: Te caritehi niddiṭṭhā samanvesitabbā keci rāgacaritā, keci dosacaritā, keci mohacaritā, keci rāgacaritā ca dosacaritā ca, keci rāgacaritā ca mohacaritā ca, keci dosacaritā ca mohacaritā ca, keci rāgacaritā ca dosacaritā ca mohacaritā ca, rāgamukhe ṭhito rāgacarito, rāgamukhe ṭhito dosacarito, rāgamukhe ṭhito mohacarito, rāgamukhe ṭhito rāgacarito ca dosacarito ca mohacarito ca, dosamukhe ṭhito dosacarito, dosamukhe ṭhito mohacarito, dosamukhe ṭhito rāgacarito, dosamukhe ṭhito rāgacarito ca dosacarito ca mohacarito ca, mohamukhe ṭhito mohacarito, mohamukhe ṭhito rāgacarito mohamukhe ṭhito dosacarito, mohamukhe ṭhito rāgacarito ca dosacarito ca mohacarito cāti, lokiyaṃ suttaṃ sattādhiṭṭhānaṃ imehi ekūnavīsatiyā puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:524.1: Vāsanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ sīlavantehi niddisitabbaṃ, te sīlavanto pañca puggalā pakatisīlaṃ samādānasīlaṃ cittappasādo samatho vipassanā cāti, vāsanābhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ imehi pañcahi puggalehi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:525.1: Lokuttaraṃ suttaṃ dhammādhiṭṭhānaṃ tīhi suttehi niddisitabbaṃ dassanabhāgiyena bhāvanābhāgiyena asekkhabhāgiyena ca.
segments.ne37:526.1: Lokiyañca lokuttarañca sattādhiṭṭhānañca dhammādhiṭṭhānañca ubhayena niddisitabbaṃ, ñāṇaṃ paññāya niddisitabbaṃ paññindriyena paññābalena adhipaññāsikkhāya dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgena sammādiṭṭhiyā tīraṇāya santīraṇāya dhamme ñāṇena anvaye ñāṇena khaye ñāṇena anuppāde ñāṇena anaññātaññassāmītindriyena aññindriyena aññātāvindriyena cakkhunā vijjāya buddhiyā bhūriyā medhāya, yaṃ yaṃ vā pana labbhati, tena tena paññādhivacanena niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:527.1: Ñeyyaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannehi ajjhattikabāhirehi hīnappaṇītehi dūrasantikehi saṅkhatāsaṅkhatehi kusalākusalābyākatehi saṅkhepato vā chahi ārammaṇehi niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:527.2: Ñāṇañca ñeyyañca tadubhayena niddisitabbaṃ, paññāpi ārammaṇabhūtā ñeyyaṃ, yaṃ kiñci ārammaṇabhūtaṃ ajjhattikaṃ vā bāhiraṃ vā, sabbaṃ taṃ saṅkhatena asaṅkhatena ca niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:528.1: Dassanaṃ bhāvanā [dassanā bhāvanā (sī.)] sakavacanaṃ paravacanaṃ visajjanīyaṃ avisajjanīyaṃ kammaṃ vipākoti sabbattha tadubhayaṃ sutte yathā niddiṭṭhaṃ, tathā upadhārayitvā labbhamānato niddisitabbaṃ, yaṃ vā pana kiñci bhagavā aññataravacanaṃ bhāsati, sabbaṃ taṃ yathāniddiṭṭhaṃ dhārayitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:529.1: Duvidho hetu yañca kammaṃ ye ca kilesā, samudayo kilesā.
segments.ne37:529.3: Samudayo saṃkilesabhāgiyena ca vāsanābhāgiyena ca suttena niddisitabbo.
segments.ne37:529.4: Tattha kusalaṃ catūhi suttehi niddisitabbaṃ vāsanābhāgiyena dassanabhāgiyena bhāvanābhāgiyena asekkhabhāgiyena ca.
segments.ne37:529.7: Anuññātaṃ bhagavato anuññātāya niddisitabbaṃ, taṃ pañcavidhaṃ saṃvaro pahānaṃ bhāvanā sacchikiriyā kappiyānulomoti, yaṃ dissati tāsu tāsu bhūmīsu, taṃ kappiyānulomena niddisitabbaṃ.
segments.ne37:529.11: So pañcavidhena veditabbo bhagavato dhammassa ariyasaṅghassa ariyadhammānaṃ sikkhāya lokiyaguṇasampattiyāti.
segments.ne37:530.1: Indriyabhūmi navahi padehi niddisitabbā, kilesabhūmi navahi padehi niddisitabbā, evametāni aṭṭhārasa padāni honti nava padāni kusalāni nava padāni akusalānīti, tathāhi vuttaṃ “aṭṭhārasa mūlapadā kuhiṃ daṭṭhabbā, sāsanappaṭṭhāne”ti.
segments.ne37:531.1: “Navahi ca padehi kusalā, navahi ca yujjanti akusalappakkhā;
segments.ne37:531.3: Ete khalu mūlapadā, bhavanti aṭṭhārasa padānī”ti.
segments.ne37:531.6: Ettāvatā samattā netti yā āyasmatā mahākaccāyanena bhāsitā bhagavatā anumoditā mūlasaṅgītiyaṃ saṅgītāti. Nettippakaraṇaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

lines: Evaṃ sabbathā nayasamuṭṭhānaṃ vibhajitvā idāni sāsanapaṭṭhānaṃ vibhajanto yasmā saṅgahavārādīsu mūlapadeheva paṭṭhānaṃ saṅgahetvā sarūpato na dassitaṃ, tasmā yathā mūlapadehi paṭṭhānaṃ niddhāretabbaṃ, evaṃ paṭṭhānatopi mūlapadāni niddhāretabbānīti dassanatthaṃ “aṭṭhārasa mūlapadā kuhiṃ daṭṭhabbā?
Sāsanassa paṭṭhānanti sāsanapaṭṭhānaṃ, sāsanaṃ desanā, tassā veneyyajjhāsayānurūpaṃ tesaṃ hitasukhanipphādanatthaṃ pakārehi ṭhānaṃ pavatti sāsanapaṭṭhānaṃ.
Tesaṃ pavattanupāyabhāvato patiṭṭhahanti etehīti paṭṭhānāni, saṃkilesādidhammā.
Tesaṃ pana samūhabhāvato ayaṃ pakaraṇappadeso paṭṭhānaṃ nāma.
“Ye te goṭṭhā paṭṭhitagāvo”ti (ma. ni.1.156) āgataṭṭhānasmiñhi yena paṭṭhānena te “goṭṭhā paṭṭhitagāvo”ti vuttā, taṃ atthato gamanaṃ hoti.

Iti nātivitthāritanayesu hāranayesu anissaṅgagamanassa desanāñāṇassa saṃkilesabhāgiyādilokiyādibhedesu tadubhayavomissakabhedesu ca vitthāritanayalābhato nissaṅgavasena pavattagamanattā te saṃkilesabhāgiyādayo lokiyādayo ca visuṃ visuṃ vomissā ca adhikaraṇavasena paṭṭhānaṃ nāma.
Tesaṃ pakāsanato ayaṃ pakaraṇappadeso paṭṭhānanti veditabbaṃ.
Vāsanā puññabhāvanā, vāsanābhāge pavattaṃ vāsanābhāgiyaṃ, vāsanaṃ bhajāpetīti vā vāsanābhāgiyaṃ.
Pariniṭṭhitasikkhādhammā asekkhā, asekkhabhāve pavattaṃ, asekkhe bhajāpetīti vā asekkhabhāgiyaṃ.
Tesu yattha taṇhādisaṃkileso vibhatto, idaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ.
Yattha sekkhā sīlakkhandhādayo vibhattā, idaṃ nibbedhabhāgiyaṃ.
Yattha pana asekkhā sīlakkhandhādayo vibhattā, idaṃ asekkhabhāgiyaṃ.
Tāni pana cha dukā cattāro tikā ekaṃ catukkaṃ aparampi ekaṃ catukkanti dvādasa honti.
Tesu cattāro dukā dve ca tikā uddhaṭā, itare na uddhaṭā, anuddharaṇe kāraṇaṃ natthi.
Iminā nayena tepi gahetuṃ sakkāti pāḷiyaṃ saṃkhittāti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
“imāni cattāri suttāni, sādhāraṇāni katāni aṭṭha bhavantī”tiādi.

Tattha yasmā katthaci sutte taṇhāsaṃkilesova niddisīyati, katthaci diṭṭhisaṃkilesova, katthaci duccaritasaṃkilesova niddisīyati, tasmā saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ tidhā vibhajitvā uddiṭṭhaṃ “taṇhāsaṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttan”tiādinā.
Tathā vodānaṃ nāma saṃkilese sati hotīti vodānabhāgiyaṃ suttaṃ saṃkilesavibhāgena tidhāva uddiṭṭhaṃ “taṇhāvodānabhāgiyaṃ suttan”tiādinā.
Taṃ pana atthato vāsanābhāgiyādi eva hoti.
“Tattha saṃkileso tividho”tiādi saṃkilesapaṭipakkhato samathādiniddhāraṇavasena vāsanābhāgiyādisuttānaṃ visayadassanatthaṃ āraddhaṃ.
Tattha yadi āsatti uppajjati bhavesūti bhavesu chandarāgaṃ pajahituṃ asakkontassa yadi bhavapatthanā uppajjati.
Evaṃ sāyanti evamassa puggalassa ayaṃ samathavipassanābhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthu bhavati pujjabhavaphalanibbattanato.
Tatrūpapattiyā saṃvattatīti tatra tatra bhave upapattiyā saṃvattati.
Imāni cattāri suttānīti imāni saṃkilesabhāgiyādīni cattāri suttāni.

Sādhāraṇāni katānīti saṃkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca, saṃkilesabhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca, saṃkilesabhāgiyañca asekkhabhāgiyañca, vāsanābhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañcāti evaṃ padantarasaṃyojanavasena missitāni katāni.
Aṭṭha bhavantīti purimāni cattāri imāni cattārīti evaṃ aṭṭha bhavanti.

Tāniyeva aṭṭha suttāni sādhāraṇāni katāni soḷasa bhavantīti tāniyeva yathāvuttāni aṭṭha suttāni vāsanābhāgiyañca asekkhabhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca, asekkhabhāgiyañca saṃkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca, nibbedhabhāgiyañca saṃkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca, asekkhabhāgiyañca saṃkilesabhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca, asekkhabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca nibbedhabhāgiyañca, asekkhabhāgiyañca saṃkilesabhāgiyañca vāsanābhāgiyañca, nibbedhabhāgiyañca asekkhabhāgiyañca nevasaṃkilesabhāgiyañca, navāsanābhāgiyañca nanibbedhabhāgiyañca na asekkhabhāgiyañcāti evaṃ sādhāraṇāni katāni purimāni aṭṭha imāni aṭṭhāti soḷasa bhavanti.
Tesu cattāro ekakā, cha dukā, cattāro tikā, eko catukko, aparopi eko catukkoti ayampi vibhāgo veditabbo.
Tatthāpi dve dukā, dve tikā, dve catukkā ca pāḷiyaṃ anāgatāti veditabbā.
Idāni imassa paṭṭhānassa sakalasāsanasaṅgahitabhāvaṃ vibhāvetuṃ “imehi soḷasahi suttehi bhinnehi navavidhaṃ suttaṃ bhinnaṃ bhavatī”ti vuttaṃ.
Tassattho – imehi saṃkilesabhāgiyādīhi soḷasahi suttehi paṭṭhānanayena vibhattehi suttageyyādinavavidhaṃ pariyattisāsanasaṅkhātaṃ suttaṃ bhinnaṃ soḷasadhā vibhattaṃ hoti.
Iminā soḷasavidhena paṭṭhānena asaṅgahito pariyattisāsanassa padeso natthīti adhippāyo.
Tattha gāthāya gāthā anuminitabbāti ayaṃ gāthā viya gāthā saṃkilesabhāgiyāti vā vāsanābhāgiyāti vā nibbedhabhāgiyāti vā asekkhabhāgiyāti vā anuminitabbā, anu anu minitvā takketvā jānitabbāti attho.
Ettha ca gāthāveyyākaraṇavinimuttā sabbā pariyatti “suttenā” tipadena saṅgahitāti daṭṭhabbā.
Idāni saṃkilesabhāgiyādīni suttāni yathāniddiṭṭhāni udāharaṇavasena vibhāvetuṃ “tattha katamaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttan”tiādi āraddhaṃ.
Tattha “kāmandhā jālasañchannā”ti gāthāya attho heṭṭhā vuttoyeva.
Yathā imassa, evaṃ ito parānampi heṭṭhā vuttatthānaṃ uttānapadānañca atthaṃ na vaṇṇayissāma.
Agatiṃ gacchatīti agantabbaṃ gatiṃ gacchati, akattabbaṃ karotīti attho.

“Manopubbaṅgamā dhammā”ti gāthāyaṃ manoti yadipi kāmāvacarakusalādibhedaṃ sabbampi catubhūmakacittaṃ mano, imasmiṃ pana ṭhāne cakkhupālattherassa (dha. pa.1-2; theragā.95) purimajātiyaṃ vejjabhūtassa uppannavasena niyamiyamānaṃ paṭighasampayuttacittameva labbhati.
So mano pubbaṅgamo etesanti manopubbaṅgamā, manasā paṭhamagāminā samannāgatāti attho.
Dhammāti nissattanijjīvaṭṭhena dhammā, te pana vedanādayo tayo arūpino khandhā.
Kathaṃ panetehi saddhiṃ ekasmiṃ vatthusmiṃ ekasmiñca ārammaṇe ekakkhaṇe uppajjamāno mano pubbaṅgamo nāma hotīti?

Yathā hi bahūsu ekato gāmaghātādikammāni karontesu “ko etesaṃ pubbaṅgamo”ti vutte yo tesaṃ paccayo hoti, yaṃ yaṃ nissāya te taṃ kammaṃ karonti, so datto vā mitto vā tesaṃ pubbaṅgamoti vuccati, evaṃsampadamidaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Iti uppādapaccayaṭṭhena mano pubbaṅgamo etesanti manopubbaṅgamā.
Na hi te mane anuppajjante uppajjituṃ sakkuṇanti, mano pana ekaccesu cetasikesu anuppajjantesupi uppajjati eva.
Yathā hi corādīnaṃ corajeṭṭhakādayo adhipatino seṭṭhā, tathā tesampi mano seṭṭho.
Yathā pana dāruādīhi nipphannāni bhaṇḍāni dārumayādīni nāma honti, tathā etepi manato nipphannattā manomayā nāma.
Paduṭṭhenāti abhijjhādīhi dosehi paduṭṭhena dūsitena bhāsati vā karoti vā.
So hi bhāsanto catubbidhaṃ vacīduccaritameva bhāsati, karontopi tividhaṃ kāyaduccaritameva karoti, abhāsanto akaronto tehi abhijjhādīhi paduṭṭhamanatāya tividhaṃ manoduccaritaṃ pūreti.
Tato naṃ dukkhamanvetīti tato tividhaduccaritato taṃ puggalaṃ dukkhaṃ anveti duccaritānubhāvena catūsu apāyesu dukkhaṃ anugacchati.
Cakkaṃva vahato padanti, yathā nāma sakaṭaṃ vahato balībaddassa padaṃ paharantaṃ cakkaṃ anugacchati, evaṃ naṃ puggalaṃ dukkhamanugacchatīti.
Gharasūkaro hi bālakālato paṭṭhāya posiyamāno thūlasarīrakāle gehato bahi nikkhamituṃ alabhanto heṭṭhāmañcādīsu samparivattitvā samparivattitvā assasanto passasanto sayateva.

Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yadā puriso middhī ca hoti mahagghaso ca, nivāpapuṭṭho mahāvarāho viya aññena iriyāpathena yāpetuṃ asakkonto niddāsīlo saṃparivattasāyī, tadā so “aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ anattā”ti tīṇi lakkhaṇāni manasi kātuṃ na sakkoti.
Tesaṃ amanasikārā mandapañño punappunaṃ gabbhaṃ upeti, gabbhavāsato na parimuccatīti.
Atidhonacārinanti dhonā vuccati cattāro paccaye idamatthitāya alametenāti paccavekkhitvā paribhuñjanapaññā, taṃ atikkamitvā caranto atidhonacārī nāma.

Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathā ayato malaṃ samuṭṭhāya yato taṃ samuṭṭhitaṃ, tameva khādati vināseti, evamevaṃ cattāro paccaye appaccavekkhitvā paribhuñjantaṃ atidhonacārinaṃ sāni kammāni attano santāne uṭṭhitattā attano santakāneva tāni kammāni duggatiṃ nayantīti.
“Coro yathā”ti gāthāyaṃ coro yathā sandhimukhe gahītoti yathā coro gharasandhiṃ chinditvā gehaṃ pavisanto gharasandhimukhe eva rājapurisehi gahito.
Sakammunā haññati bajjhate cāti tena attanā katakammena kasābhitāḷanādinā haññati ceva addubandhanādinā bajjhati ca.
Evaṃ ayaṃ pecca pajā paratthāti evampi ayaṃ pāpakārinī pajā ito cavitvā paraloke.
Sakammunā haññati bajjhate cāti attanāva katena pāpakammena nirayādīsu nānappakārehi kammakāraṇādīhi haññati ceva paribajjhati cāti.
“Sukhakāmānī”ti gāthāyaṃ yo daṇḍena vihiṃsatīti yo puggalo daṇḍena vā leḍḍuādīhi vā vibādhati.
Pecca so na labhe sukhanti so puggalo paraloke manussasukhaṃ vā dibbasukhaṃ vā na labhati, nibbānasukhe pana vattabbameva natthi.
Jimhaṃ gacchati puṅgavoti yadi yūthapati usabho kuṭilaṃ gacchati.
Sabbā tā jimhaṃ gacchantīti sabbāpi tā gāviyo kuṭilameva gacchanti.
Nette jimhaṃ gate satīti nettari kuṭilaṃ gate sati, nettassa kuṭilaṃ gatattāti attho.
So hi tāsaṃ paccayiko upaddavaharo ca.
“Evamevan”ti gāthāyaṃ yathā cetaṃ, evamevaṃ yo manussesu padhānasammato, yadi so adhammacārī siyā.
Ye tassa anujīvino, sabbepi adhammikāva honti.
Yasmā ca etadeva, tasmā sabbaṃ raṭṭhaṃ dukkhaṃ seti, rājā ce hoti adhammiko.
Kukkuccajanakeneva pattavaṭṭippabhavassa upacchinnattā phaluppatti kadaliyā parābhavāya hotīti āha –
Tathā phalapariyosānattā osadhīnaṃ “phalaṃ veḷuṃ phalaṃ naḷan”ti vuttaṃ.
Vaḷavāya kucchismiṃ gadrabhassa jātā assatarī nāma, sā gabbhaṃ gaṇhitvā kāle sampatte vijāyituṃ na sakkoti.
Pādehi bhūmiṃ paharantī tiṭṭhati, athassa cattāro pāde catūsu khāṇukesu bandhitvā kucchiṃ phāletvā potakaṃ nīharanti, sā tattheva marati.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yathā attano phalaṃ kadaliveḷunaḷepi vināseti, gabbho ca assatariṃ, evaṃ attano kammaphalabhūto sakkāro asappurisaṃ vināsetīti.
Kodhamakkhagarūti kujjhanalakkhaṇaṃ kodhaṃ, paraguṇamakkhanalakkhaṇaṃ makkhañca garuṃ katvā uddhaṃ katvā ukkhipitvā caranto.
“ekaṃ dhammaṃ atītassā”tiādi (dha. pa.176), tathā “evaṃ parittaṃ kho, rāhula, tesaṃ sāmaññaṃ, yesaṃ natthi sampajānamusāvāde lajjā”tiādi (ma. ni.2.108).
Taṃ kathaṃ nu bhavissatīti taṃ dhanaṃ kena nu pakārena tesaṃ bhavissati.
Adhammena tesaṃ sambhatattā tesu naciraṭṭhitikaṃ hotīti attho.
Sā hi rūpādīhi sobhanehi aggoti saggoti adhippetā.
Lobhā khaṇati attānanti lobhahetu apuññāni karonto kāyavisamādiyogena attānaṃ khaṇati nāma.
Bālāti idhalokatthaṃ paralokatthañca ajānantā idha bālā nāma.
Na hi paññāya duṭṭhattaṃ nāma atthi.

Na taṃ kammaṃ kataṃ sādhu, yaṃ katvā anutappatīti yaṃ kammaṃ nirayādīsu nibbattanasamatthaṃ dukkhudayaṃ katvā anussaritānussaritakkhaṇe anutappati anusocati, taṃ kataṃ na sādhu na sundaraṃ na bhaddakaṃ.
Yassa assumukhoti yassa assūhi tintamukho rodanto vipākaṃ paṭisevati anubhoti.
Samādānato paṭṭhāya khaṇḍaṃ akatvā visesato ādibrahmacariyakassa carimakacittaṃ pāpetabbatāya duttitikkhaṃ, sīlasaṃvarādayo vā aparikkhate katvā sampādetuṃ asakkuṇeyyatāya dukkaraṃ.
Atha vā dukkarantipadassa atthaṃ dassetuṃ duttitikkhanti vuttaṃ.

Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – yaṃ paṇḍitā kulaputtā dasapi vassāni vīsatipi … pe … saṭṭhipi vassāni dantebhi dantamādhāya jivhāya tāluṃ āhacca cetasā cittaṃ abhiniggaṇhitvā ekāsanaṃ ekabhattaṃ paṭisevamānā āpāṇakoṭikaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carantā sāmaññaṃ karonti, taṃ bālā abyattā kātuṃ na sakkontīti.
Bahūhi tattha sambādhāti tasmiṃ sāmaññasaṅkhāte ariyamagge bahū sambādhā, maggādhigamāya paṭipannassa bahū parissayāti attho.
Appameyyaṃ paminantoti appameyyaṃ khīṇāsavapuggalaṃ “ettakasīlo ayaṃ ettakasamādhi ettakapañño”ti evaṃ minanto.
Kodha vidvā vikappayeti ko idha vidvā medhāvī vikappeyya, khīṇāsavova khīṇāsavaṃ minanto vikappeyyāti dīpeti.
Nivutaṃ maññeti yo pana puthujjano minetuṃ ārabhati, taṃ nivutaṃ avakujjapaññaṃ maññāmi.
Evaṃ viraddhaṃ pātetīti viraddhaṃ aparaddhaṃ khalitapuggalaṃ evaṃ apāyesu vinipāteti.
Vācā dubbhāsitā yathāti yathā vācā ariyūpavādanavasena dubbhāsitā.
Taṃ vā nindati yo pasaṃsiyoti yo guṇavisiṭṭhatāya pasaṃsāraho puggalo, taṃ vā so pāpicchatādīni āropetvā garahati.
Sabbassāpi sahāpi attanāti sabbena attano dhanenāpi attanāpi saddhiṃ.
Sugatesūti sobhanagamanattā, sundaraṃ ṭhānaṃ gatattā, sammā gatattā, sammā ca gadattā sugatasaṅkhātesu buddhādīsu.
Manaṃ padosayeti yo manaṃ padoseyya, tassa ayaṃ manopadoso eva mahattaro kalīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Tasmā vassagaṇanāya ettako so kālo, yaṃ kālaṃ ariyagarahivācaṃ manañca paṇidhāya pāpakaṃ nirayaṃ upeti, tattha paccatīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Idañca saṅkhepena padumaniraye āyuppamāṇaṃ, vitthārena pana parato āgamissati.
Lobhaguṇeti “guṇo”ti bālehi diṭṭhattā, anekakkhattuṃ pavattitattā ca lobhoyeva lobhaguṇo, tasmiṃ lobhaguṇe, taṇhāyāti attho.
Kokālikañhi mīyamānaṃ ovadantena āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena bhāsitā imā gāthāti.
Mā bahubhāṇidha nerayikosīti idāni bahubhāṇī mā hohi, nerayiko asi jāto.
Idaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyanti idaṃ taṇhādīnaṃ sabhāvabhedato avatthābhedato ca anekabhedakaṃ dassetuṃ anekehi suttapadehi udāharaṇavasena dassitaṃ saṃkilesabhāgiyaṃ suttanti veditabbaṃ.
Yesu paviṭṭhamaggeneva niggacchanti, te sambādhā byūhakā etthāti sambādhabyūhaṃ.
Bhantenāti damathaṃ anupagatena, ito cito ca paribbhamantena vā.
Pecca so labhateti yo bhūte daṇḍena na hiṃsati, so puggalo paraloke manussabhūto manussasukhaṃ devabhūto dibbasukhaṃ ubhayaṃ atikkanto nibbānasukhaṃ labhatīti attho.

Sattahi kāraṇehi buddhā bhagavanto janapadacārikaṃ caranti – desantaragatānaṃ veneyyānaṃ vinayanattaṃ, tatra ṭhitānaṃ ussukkasamuppādanaṃ, bhāvakānaṃ ekasmiṃ ṭhāne nibaddhavāsapariharaṇaṃ attano ca tattha anāsaṅgadassanaṃ, sambuddhavasitaṭṭhānatāya desānaṃ cetiyabhāvasampādanaṃ, bahūnaṃ sattānaṃ dassanūpasaṅkamanādīhi puññoghappasavanaṃ, avuṭṭhiādiupaddavūpasamanañcāti imehi sattahi kāraṇehi buddhā bhagavanto janapadacārikaṃ carantīti veditabbaṃ.
Isidattapurāṇāti isidatto ca purāṇo ca, tesu isidatto sakadāgāmī.
Magge purisaṃ ṭhapesunti tesaṃ kira gāmadvārena bhagavato gamanamaggo, tasmā “sace bhagavā amhākaṃ suttānaṃ vā pamattānaṃ vā gaccheyya, atha passituṃ na labheyyāmā”ti maggamajjhe purisaṃ ṭhapesuṃ.
